Regarding the civilization and education of truth, it is a great necessity for the well-being of the Pashtun and the Pashtun himself that steps be taken at the national level to establish a system that creates a broad and standard education system for the people of the country. This is a path in which every citizen of the country can obtain their right. For the importance of this education, it is necessary that efforts be made at the national level to create a curriculum that enhances the mental abilities of the people. Its goal should be the promotion of science and knowledge for the progress of the homeland, not just for a specific class. The current system that exists pays attention to the interests of a specific class, due to which many members of our society are left without education. We must try to ensure that education is in accordance with the needs of the people and that every citizen can benefit from the blessings of education in their own country. No matter how many obstacles there are in this path, we must move forward for a bright future and work for the progress of our country in the light of knowledge. Our goal should not just be building schools, but creating an environment in which everyone has equal opportunity for learning. With this, every individual in our society will participate in the progress of the country and a strong society will be created.
687.left:
A short note on the great need for the development of true civilization and education:

In reality, national education is an essential step for the common interests of all and the well-being of society. Unfortunately, the current system in the field of education has a series of shortcomings, due to which the people of the country remain deprived of their true right. In these circumstances, a major change is needed in the field of education that will open the doors of knowledge for every citizen of the country. Current education is for a limited circle, while education as a social right should reach everyone. For the development of education, it is necessary to formulate policies at the government level that take into account the needs of the people and take practical steps for the progress of the country. In this way, the people of our society will not only be equipped with the light of knowledge, but will also shine in the world as a strong and developed society. It is the duty of every Pashtun to strive for the popularization of education and to raise their voice for this important task.

On May 28, 1939, the twenty-first independence celebration of the Pashtun nation
was completed with glory, splendor, and happiness. On this
in Peshawar, Mr. Muhammad Hakim Khan Sahib, a lawyer, invited the Pashtuns
and held a grand feast in honor of the respected Pashtuns. And on the
occasion of the feast, the honorable Khan Muhammad Hakim Khan, [to the] respected guests
spoke in praise of Pashto. In it, the memorable name
of Ghazi Muhammad Nadir Khan, the conqueror, and his eternal achievements were described. And the current
King, His Majesty Muhammad Zahir Shah's government's blessings were explained
by him - and along with it, the highness of Sardar Muhammad Hashim Khan Sahib
and His Highness Sardar Shah Wali Khan and His Highness Sardar Shah
Mahmud Khan's great achievements were praised - and the ceremony
ended with great happiness.

and pray for the soul of the freedom-loving Pashtun nation.

A look at Albania

Albania's (late) King "Ahmed Zogu" is one of those figures of the world who, due to his merit and courage, rose above his ordinary status.

This king's story is the story of the death of Jelal Bey, among the tribes of Albania. Besides his status as a merchant, Jelal Bey was also the trusted deputy of Sultan Abdul Hamid. He was born in 1895. Ahmed Zogu was educated in the Albanian way. Until 1915, Albania was part of the Turkish government. But when a freedom movement started against the Sultan's corrupt government in Turkey, Ahmed Zogu began to think about the freedom of his own country. At the age of twenty, he joined the movement. He endured exile, imprisonment, and the hardships of war. Finally, he succeeded in his goal. In 1924 he became the Prime Minister of Albania, and in 1925 he became the head of Albania. Finally, in 1928, due to his ability and power, he was made King of Albania, and he took the title "Zogu".

During the time of the freedom movement, he faced many enemies. The people of Albania, like the Wazirs, believed in blood feuds. Controlling these bloodthirsty people was not an easy task. Ahmed Zogu was a brave man. He was successful in controlling them. He was always cautious about his enemies. There were reports of him killing three hundred (300) people. Many attempts were made to assassinate him, but fate saved him, and he remained alive.

He kept his palace under the protection of machine guns and often did not participate in public meetings.

Ahmed Zogu was a very learned man. He could speak German, French, Turkish, and Serbian. He was fond of studying history and spent his lonely nights busy with work for the betterment of the country.

Zogu was very skilled in maintaining law and order among the people. He brought his enemies under control through his good behavior. Whenever he found out that someone intended to rebel, he would invite them to the palace and bring them under control through his polite behavior.

A priest, Fan Noli, was his very staunch enemy. When Zogu came to power, he exiled him. He lived in America for a long time. Finally, he became very ill, and the money for his treatment ---

A message of condolence from Pashtun
The struggle of Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan for the service of the nation is an example that will always be a torch for future generations. He spent most of his life for the unity of the Pashtuns and for winning their rights. In his death, not only his family but the entire Pashtun nation is in grief. Remembering his services and following his path is the duty of every Pashtun. We pray for his forgiveness at the threshold of God. May God Almighty grant patience to his family and all his friends. Amen.

A message of condolence from Pashtun on the death of Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan
Alas and a hundred times alas that today a great leader like Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan, a fighter for the path of the nation's freedom who always raised his voice against the oppression and tyranny of the British, is no longer among us to understand the heart's pain and sorrow of the nation. His passing is a great tragedy for the entire nation. In this grief, not only his family and friends but all those who dreamed of the independence and prosperity of the homeland are in mourning. The history of Khan Sahib Khudai Dad Khan's life and struggle is a bright example for those who are ready to sacrifice their lives for the path of truth and reality. With his death, a page of the struggles of Pashtunkhwa has been turned. May God have mercy on him and grant him a place in Paradise. We express our sympathy to his family and survivors in this grief.

Those Pashtuns who strive for a specific development in recognizing their ethnicity and rights, and in the path of protecting the interests of all, it is necessary for them never to show weakness in recognizing their rights in their social affairs in the light of knowledge and truth. They must, in order to protect their national and ethnic interests, prevent the conspiracies of their enemies in all circumstances by maintaining a spirit of unity and cooperation with one another, and be ready to make any sacrifice for the service of their homeland and their people.

Protecting the rights of the Pashtun nation
In recent times, many atrocities and excesses have been committed against Pashtuns, but to prevent this, it is necessary to raise a strong voice for the unity of Pashtuns and the protection of their rights. Our people must understand that their rights are not at anyone's mercy, but are achieved as a result of their own efforts and unity. If we want to live in this world as an honorable nation, then we must rise as an organized force to demand our rights.

898.right:
In Memory of Tipu Sultan

30
August 1939

In a state where the dark clouds of slavery were spread over many parts of India, in a corner of the Indian soil known as Mysore, a shining star rose that lit the lamp of hope for freedom in the hearts of Indians. This shining star was "Tipu Sultan," who had dedicated his entire life to the path of freedom.

Tipu Sultan was not only a wise politician but also a brave military leader. He understood that for the freedom of India, a disciplined and united voice was needed against the British. He established contacts with leaders from various parts of India and urged them to stand against colonialism.

An important part of his life is his confrontation with the British. He defeated the British armies in many battles and halted their expansionist policies. His bravery and perseverance were a source of inspiration for the people of that time.

But unfortunately, due to some traitors and those who sided with foreigners, Tipu Sultan joined the ranks of martyrs in a crucial battle. His death was a great loss to the struggle for India's freedom, but his message and love for freedom remained forever in the hearts of Indians.

In conclusion, we can say that Tipu Sultan's struggle is an excellent example of an untiring effort for the truth. He believed that freedom is the right of every human being and that it is permissible to make any sacrifice for this right. Although he is not among us today, his achievements and his love for the homeland are written forever in our history.

It is essential for us to learn from the life of Tipu Sultan that we should always have a spirit of sacrifice for the freedom and dignity of our homeland. If we want to leave a dignified and free India for our future generations, we must follow in the footsteps of such leaders who sacrificed their lives for truth and justice.

This lamp of freedom that Tipu Sultan lit must be kept alive by all of us together today. It is our national duty to keep the memory of such heroes fresh and work for the progress of our country according to their guidance. The soul of Tipu Sultan will be happy when we stand on our own feet for the freedom and survival of our homeland.

The situation in foreign countries
The confrontation between Germany and France. According to news from London, it has become known that German troops are gathering in three large border regions of Germany. The German army has moved towards the southern side of Moselle and Saarbrücken. The confrontation between the French and German armies has begun, and both sides are fighting. One report says that on the Siegfried Line, there is not much activity, and the French are fighting with great bravery. A military expert has estimated the power of both governments, stating that Germany has 100,000 soldiers on the front line, while France has 500,000 soldiers prepared for war. From a French announcement, it has become known that Germany will attack the French with great force, as France has occupied territory beyond the border, and they will certainly try to reclaim it. If they attack Saarbrücken, they might suffer a loss of 100,000 troops, although the French have made great preparations. The gathering of Russian troops: London reports that Russian troops have gathered on the borders of Baku and the Caucasus, but it is not yet clear what this means. 976.right:
Situation in foreign countries
War preparations in Iran and Iraq: The Al-Ahram newspaper writes that war preparations are underway in Iran. There are reports of a large military buildup in Qazvin, Khorasan, and Isfahan. There are reports of military concentration along the Iranian border in the areas of Iraq or towards the deserts of western Iraq. In this regard, there are also reports of some other military activities in the eastern and northern parts of Iran. This is a matter of great concern, because as a result of these measures, a kind of tension may arise in the relations between Iran and these countries.
The new series of talks regarding the wall and the border between Iran and Iraq is also a matter of concern. No new news has been published by the Iraqi government in this regard. However, signs of special measures being taken in response to these actions by Iran are visible. The possibility of continued conflict over the borders between the two countries is high, and regional stability is facing a threat.

1005.right:
Page 30

11 November 1931

The decision of the Grand National Jirga

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A petition

We have received news that in various places, rumors are circulating that a certain group of people has published a document that is having a very negative impact on the people and that such talk is spreading disunity within the nation. Regarding this document, we clarify the following:

(1) Syed Abdul Rahman Sahib Kaka Khel is a person whose words and actions have always been driven by the spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and harmony of the nation; the accusations published against him are baseless.

(2) Mian Attaullah Sahib Kaka Khel is a person who has always played his intellectual and practical part for the progress of his nation, and the accusations published against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karamat Shah Sahib's letter of appreciation for Polad, it became clear that his intention and that of his companions is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Much more is being said about the aforementioned Khan regarding the document mentioned above, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the pride of his nation and stands firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1005.left:
In this regard, we strongly state that such rumors are spread to create discord among the people and to work for the interests of the colonialists. We call upon all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

It has been decided by the members of the Grand Tribal Council that the entire nation will remain united and will work together to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles to the unity of the nation.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people become aware of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of outsiders.

We are firm in our goal and will not refrain from any sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with the unity of the nation, this path will become easy.

1059.right:
Situation in foreign countries
War preparations in Iran and Iraq. Al-Ahram newspaper writes that war preparations are underway in Iran. There are reports of a large military buildup in Qazvin, Khorasan, and Isfahan. There are reports of military concentration along the Iranian border near the deserts of western Iraq and some areas of Iraq. In this regard, there are also reports of some other military activities in the eastern and northern parts of Iran. This is a matter of great concern, because as a result of these measures, a kind of tension may arise in the relations between Iran and these countries.
The new series of talks regarding the border and walls between Iran and Iraq is also a matter of concern. No new news has been published by the Iraqi government in this regard. However, signs of special measures being taken in response to these actions by Iran are visible. The possibility of continued conflict over the borders between the two countries is high, and regional stability is facing a threat.

1088.right:
Page 30

11 November 1931

The decision of the Great National Jirga

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A petition

We have received news that in various places, rumors are circulating that a certain group of people has published a document that is having a very negative impact on the public, and such talk is spreading disunity within the nation. Regarding this document, we clarify the following:

(1) Syed Abdul Rahman Sahib Kakhail is a person whose words and actions have always been driven by a spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and harmony of the nation; the accusations published against him are baseless.

(2) Mian Attaullah Sahib Kakhail is a person who has always played his intellectual and practical part for the progress of his nation, and the accusations published against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karamat Shah Sahib's letter of appreciation for Polad, it became clear that his intention and that of his companions is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Regarding the aforementioned Khan and the document mentioned above, much more is being said, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the pride of his nation and stands firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1088.left:
In this regard, we firmly state that such rumors are spread to create discord among the people and to work for the interests of the colonialists. We call upon all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

It has been decided by the members of the Grand Tribal Jirga that the entire nation will remain united and will work together to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles to the unity of the nation.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people become aware of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of outsiders.

We are firm in our goal and will not refrain from any sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with the unity of the nation, this path will become easy.

The Congress has clearly stated its policy regarding the influence exerted on India and the response given to the people of the country. The Working Committee views this with satisfaction. 11 November 1931

The decision of the Grand National Jirga

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A petition

We have received news that in various places, rumors are circulating that a certain group of people has published a document that is having a very negative impact among the people, and such talk spreads disunity in the nation. Regarding this document, we clarify the following:

(1) Sayyid Abdul Rahman Sahib Kakhel is a person whose words and actions have always been driven by the spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and harmony of the nation; the accusations published against him are baseless.

(2) Mian Attaullah Sahib Kakhel is a person who has always played his academic and practical role for the progress of his nation, and the accusations published against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karamat Shah Sahib’s letter of appreciation for Polad, it became clear that his intention and that of his companions is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Regarding the aforementioned Khan and the document mentioned above, much more is being said, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the pride of his nation and has stood firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1151.left:
In this regard, we firmly state that such rumors are spread so that discord is created among the people and to work for the interests of the colonialists. We call upon all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

It has been decided by the members of the Grand Tribal Council (Loya Jirga) that the entire nation will remain united and will make joint efforts to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles to the unity of the nation.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people become aware of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of outsiders.

We are firm in our goal and will not refrain from any kind of sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with the unity of the nation, this path will become easy.

November 11, 1931

Decision of the Grand National Jirga

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A Petition

We have received news that in closed circles, such talk is spreading as if a group of people have circulated a certain article among themselves that has a very bad effect on the people, and such talk spreads disunity among the nation. We clarify these points regarding this article:

(1) Sayed Abdul Rahman Sahib Kakhil is a person whose words and actions have always contained the spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and agreement of the nation. The accusations spread about him are baseless.

(2) Mian Attaullah Sahib Kakhil is a person who has always played his academic and practical role for the progress of his nation, and the accusations spread against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karamat Shah Sahib's "Pulad Spasnama" (Steel's Gratitude), it became clear that his and his friends' intention is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Much more can be said about the aforementioned Khan regarding the above-mentioned article, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the pride of his nation and stands firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1216.left:
Regarding this, we strongly say that such rumors are spread to create disunity among the people and to serve the interests of the colonizers. We call on all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

The members of the Grand National Jirga have decided that the entire nation will be united and will strive together to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles to national unity.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people are informed of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of foreigners.

We are firm in our goal and will not shy away from any sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with national unity, this path will become easier.

Page 30

11 November 1931

Decision of the Grand National Assembly

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A Petition

We have received news that in some places, such talks are being published as if a group of people has published an article among themselves that leaves very bad impressions among the people, and such talks spread disunity in the nation. Regarding this article, we make these statements clear:

(1) Syed Abdul Rahman Sahib Kakhel is a person in whose words and actions there has always been a spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and agreement of the nation. The accusations published about him are baseless.

(2) Mian Ataullah Sahib Kakhel is a person who has always played his academic and practical role for the progress of his nation, and the accusations published against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karam Shah Sahib's Polad Spasnama, it became clear that his and his friends' intention is for the unity of the nation, and he has always remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Regarding the mentioned Khan, much more is being said about the above-mentioned article, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the upliftment of his nation and stands firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1277.left:
Regarding this, we strongly say that such rumors are spread to create disunity among the people and to work for the interests of the colonialists. We call upon all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

By the members of the Grand National Jirga, it has been decided in this regard that the entire nation will be united and will strive together to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles in the unity of the nation.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people become aware of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of foreigners.

We are firm on our goal and will not shy away from any sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with the unity of the nation, this path will become easier.

1290.right:
Pashtun Editorial
This monthly magazine named "Pashtun," which was published in 1929, discusses on this page the importance of unity, brotherhood, and mutual assistance among Pashtuns. At the beginning of the text, a call for Pashtun unity is made, and then the benefits of this and the harms of discord are explained in detail. The text begins as follows:
The benefit of every Pashtun lies in the benefit of the nation; therefore, it is necessary for everyone to join hands. For the progress of this nation, the path of consensus should be taken instead of prejudice. If we unite among ourselves, then no one will dare to look at us with evil intentions. In this article, emphasis is also placed on the importance of knowledge and wisdom, and the youth are requested to strive for education to serve their nation. This article concludes with the slogan of Pashtun national unity.
1290.left: In my opinion, if we want to become a strong nation, we must adapt ourselves to the demands of the times while preserving our traditions. In particular, women's education and the training of the youth are what shape our future. In every section of this issue of Pashtun, various stories and advice regarding unity have been written. This magazine presents a vivid picture of the social situation of that time and is a step towards efforts for unity among the Pashtuns. It is hoped that the contents of this magazine will bring about a positive change in the minds of the readers.

Page 30

11 November 1931

The decision of the Grand National Jirga

And the reasons for taking practical steps

A request

We have received news that in various places, rumors are circulating that a certain group of people has published a document that is having a very negative impact on the people, and such talk is spreading disunity within the nation. Regarding this document, we clarify the following:

(1) Sayyid Abdul Rahman Sahib Kaka Khel is a person whose words and actions have always been driven by a spirit of goodwill for the nation, and he has always strived for the unity and harmony of the nation; the accusations published against him are baseless.

(2) Mian Attaullah Sahib Kaka Khel is a person who has always played his intellectual and practical part for the progress of his nation, and the accusations published against him are far from the truth.

(3) With the publication of Karamat Shah Sahib's "Polad" commendation, it has become clear that his intention and that of his companions is for the unity of the nation, and he has remained steadfast on the path of sacrifice for the freedom of the country.

(4) Regarding the aforementioned Khan and the document mentioned above, much more is being said, but by looking at his past life and achievements, it is proven that he has always strived for the pride of his nation and stands firm against all kinds of conspiracies.
1324.left:
In this regard, we strongly state that such rumors are spread to create discord among the people and to work for the interests of the colonialists. We call upon all patriots and nationalists not to be deceived by such conspiracies.

It has been decided by the members of the Grand Tribal Jirga that the entire nation will remain united and will work together to achieve independence. We stand against anyone who creates obstacles to the unity of the nation.

Spread this decision in all regions so that all people become aware of the truth. We must maintain an atmosphere of brotherhood among ourselves and not fall into the conspiracies of outsiders.

We are firm in our goal and will not refrain from any sacrifice to achieve independence. The path to freedom is difficult, but with the unity of the nation, this path will become easy.

A resolution regarding the Congress's performance
In the third week of the new month, the resolution passed by the All-India National Assembly's working committee (Congress Working Committee) in Allahabad is as follows.
Congress has made clear its policy regarding the influence exerted over India and the response given to the people of the country. The Working Committee views this with satisfaction. This policy is reflected in the statements of August 4 and September 1, as well as in the numerous speeches made on various occasions. Subsequent events and circumstances have justified the evolution and appropriateness of this Congress policy. The nature of the war, especially the current policy of Britain and France, and the declarations made by Britain regarding India, indicate that, like the previous world war, this war is also being fought for imperialist purposes, and British imperialism seeks to further strengthen its foothold in India. Congress cannot provide any support for this type of war and policy, and it cannot allow the intentions of this purpose to take unfair advantage of the people of India. The Working Committee has stated in clear and unambiguous terms that democracy and imperialism are incompatible with the objectives of the war in India, and specifically...

The prosperity of the Turks is their own. But in India, what will the Muslims do? Turkey is free. Congress has made clear its policy regarding the speech and the influence it exerts over India, and the response it has given to the people of the country. 1682.right:
Tipu Sultan's Memory

30
August 1939 AD

In such a situation, when dark clouds of slavery were spread over many parts of India, in such a corner of the land of India, which is known as Mysore, a shining star emerged that lit the lamp of hope for freedom in the hearts of Indians. This shining star was "Tipu Sultan", who dedicated his entire life to the path of freedom.

Tipu Sultan was not only a shrewd politician but also a brave military leader. He understood that for the freedom of India, a systematic and united voice was needed against the British. He established contacts with leaders from different parts of India and urged them to stand against colonialism.

An important part of his life was his confrontation with the British. He defeated the British armies in many battles and prevented their expansionist policies. His bravery and perseverance were a source of inspiration for the people of that time.

But unfortunately, due to some traitors and allies of foreigners, Tipu Sultan joined the ranks of martyrs in an important battle. His death was a great loss in India's struggle for freedom, but his message and love for freedom remained forever in the hearts of Indians.

In conclusion, we can say that Tipu Sultan's struggle is an excellent example of an untiring effort for justice. He believed that freedom is the right of every human being and that any sacrifice for this right is permissible. Although he is not among us today, his achievements and his love for the homeland are forever written in our history.

It is essential for us to learn this lesson from Tipu Sultan's life: to always have the spirit of sacrifice for the freedom and dignity of our homeland. If we want to leave a dignified and free India for our future generations, then we must follow in the footsteps of leaders who sacrificed their lives for truth and justice.

This lamp of freedom that Tipu Sultan lit, today we all must collectively preserve. It is our national duty to keep the memory of such heroes fresh and to work for the progress of our country according to their guidance. Tipu Sultan's soul will be happy when we stand on our own feet for the freedom and survival of our homeland.

1755.right:
Pashtun Editorial
This monthly magazine named "Pashtun," published in 1929, discusses on this page the importance of unity, brotherhood, and mutual assistance among Pashtuns. At the beginning of the text, a call for Pashtun unity is made, followed by a detailed explanation of its benefits and the harms of discord. The text begins as follows:
The benefit of the nation is the benefit of every Pashtun; therefore, it is necessary for all to unite. For the progress of this nation, the path of consensus should be taken instead of prejudice. If we unite among ourselves, no one will dare to look at us with ill intent. This article also emphasizes the importance of knowledge and education, and calls upon the youth to strive for education in order to serve their nation. The article concludes with a slogan for the unity of the Pashtun nation.
1755.left: In my opinion, if we want to become a strong nation, we must adapt ourselves to the demands of the times while preserving our traditions. In particular, women's education and the training of the youth are what shape our future. In every section of this issue of Pashtun, various stories and advice regarding unity have been written. This magazine presents a vivid picture of the social situation of that time and is a step towards efforts for unity among the Pashtuns. It is hoped that the contents of this magazine will bring about a positive change in the minds of the readers.

Magazine: Da Pashtun

Month of Ghwayi (May/June)

Service to God's Creation

A Notice
Regarding the publication of the second year of Pashtun
Awakened Pashtun in 1928

Serving God's creation is a virtue that has been mentioned extensively in the holy religion of Islam. The Prophet (PBUH) has said: "God's creation is God's family, so the most beloved of God's creation to God is the one who does good to His family," meaning God's creation is God's family, so the one most beloved to God is the one who shows kindness to His family (creation). In the light of the holy religion of Islam, when we look towards serving the people of Pashtunkhwa and humanity in general, it becomes incumbent upon us to gird our loins for this service. The Pashtun magazine, which was established for this very purpose, intends to present such content to its readers that will lead to the elevation of their knowledge and national consciousness. We hope that our writing contributors will assist us in this path, so that we may become capable of serving our nation.

4- Lytton and his policy:
Lytton is a very important and influential name in the series of international affairs of that time, who held a special position in the politics of British India. He had a unique perspective regarding the issue of the northwestern frontier regions of India. In Lytton's view, the solution to the Afghanistan issue was vital for the survival of British India. During his rule of India, Lytton adopted a policy that emphasized strengthening relations with the rulers of Afghanistan, but at the same time, he wanted the control of Afghanistan's internal affairs to be in the hands of British India. In his writings regarding this policy, Lytton stated: "We should not view Afghanistan as a power that only protects India's interests, but rather we should try to make Afghanistan a state that acts in accordance with our policies."

2790.right:
Freedom
Freedom of nations:-
It is clear that it is the desire of a group that it should be its own master and leader—in the same way, it is also the aspiration of a nation or community that it should take advantage of its freedom and rule over itself. If, out of compulsion, someone else's government is imposed upon it, then it considers that extreme humiliation and disgrace.
Here, if the question is asked whether, if all nations were in agreement, could they become one?
The answer to this is that this issue is based on a major foundation—that if two nations are in agreement regarding religion, language, customs and traditions, and interests and losses, then their becoming two nations is not actually harmful. But if they are not behind one another, but rather in conflict and competition—
And if, in the aforementioned statement, both nations are affected in certain things, then saying they are not one nation is a severe detriment. In this case, for the subjugated nation, "freedom" is a matter of life. Such as England and India.
And if this question is asked, what is the benefit of "independence" after subjugation?
The believer says that there is another great benefit. 2803.right: It is good that these few words came at the beginning of my speech, and this is also so that my dear readers may understand that in these sittings of mine, there are many other tasks that must be completed before this. However, these sittings are intended for my dear brothers to understand what has passed through my heart during this time that has gone by. There have been many times when I have not known whether to do this or not, but in order for my brothers to be informed of these circumstances, I do this. In the course of some of the events of my past time, which I will narrate to you one by one, there was a condition on that day that contained much within itself. And because in these circumstances, which I had taken upon myself for the good of this nation, I saw many difficulties in carrying out these tasks, and my heart was very fearful upon seeing the fate of these works, wondering how this task would be brought to an end and what state my nation would be in. However, there were many other such matters in this that, for the sake of my nation understanding this situation, I was compelled to write this whole story briefly, so that my other brothers might also be informed of how my heart felt during that time regarding the conditions of my nation, how exhausted I became in these tasks, and that for the service of this nation, I have carried out other works as well, relying on God Almighty, which have resulted in the benefit of the nation.
2803.left:
In conclusion, it must be said that the purpose of my writing is not to show off, but rather that my brothers become informed about the actual circumstances of this time, and that this is history, which must be preserved for future generations. If this work had not been done at that time, these events might have faded from people's memories and the space for the truths of that era would have remained empty in the pages of history. Thus, in this writing of mine, an attempt has been made to mention every difficulty and joy on the path of serving the nation in the light of the truths of the time. It is hoped that this writing will gain the attention of my dear readers and become a cause for stirring sentiments of service to the nation and the country in their minds. These sittings are not just a statement of my heart's condition, but a mirror of a time that reflects a sensitive period in the life of the Afghan nation. Finally, I pray in the court of God Almighty that He spreads peace, stability, and the light of knowledge and wisdom in our country, and enables our young generation to work bravely for the progress of their country and nation. Because the progress of a nation depends on the determination and action of every individual. With respect.

(June)

Independent


Regarding what is said about the people of the Peshawar region of India during the Indian independence movement, this is the pain of the hearts of the Muslims of this region and the answers to the questions of the Indian struggle for independence. The fact that these regions have such a great place in the history of Muslims, from the past travel of their own Muslims to India and the beginning of the spread of religion in these regions through the preaching of the faith, has prepared the people of this region to sacrifice themselves. Likewise, with the arrival of the British, these Muslim regions have stood as a resistance through the slogan of unity and brotherhood, in the path of the demand for freedom.

While the arrival of colonialism in these Muslim regions led to the efforts of these people through the sacrifice of their lives and property, they continued their efforts to preserve their religious and national values as a slogan for the demand for independence by the Muslims of India. In the same way, among the Muslims, the development of this spirit of demand for freedom and the struggle of the people of this region against the cruelty and tyranny of the British, through their own consensus, has led them to employ all their efforts to make any kind of sacrifice.
2810.left:
Then, their contribution to the struggle for freedom and the spirit of sacrifice in that path, for the Muslims of this region in India, is commendable. The people of this region have always tried to stand against the oppression and tyranny of the British by preserving their religious and moral values. In the same way, the freedom-seeking spirit of the Muslims of this region has remained an example and a model for the Muslims of India. This struggle of the Muslims of this region stands as a great sign of the unity and consensus of the Muslims of India and as resistance against British colonialism.

Furthermore, in the path of this struggle of the Muslims in these regions, they have carried out their efforts in strengthening the spirit of unity and consensus of the Muslims as a result of the sacrifices made. Therefore, for the Muslims of India, the sacrifices of the Muslims of this region in the path of continuing the quest for freedom and the struggle against British colonialism are worthy of being remembered forever. And this struggle will remain recorded forever in the pages of history as the path for the freedom-seeking of the Muslims of India.

2819.right:
Third - The blessings of independence
God (J) has Himself stated in the Quran, "And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him," meaning if anyone relies on God, He is enough for him; this matter must be kept in the balance of the heart. This is not just a matter of the tongue, but requires proving in practice. If one truly relies on God, there is no force on the face of the earth that can stand as an obstacle to the will of a nation.
By the blessing of independence, our holy homeland was saved from the pit of discord and took steps toward unity. Throughout their history, the children of this country have always been seekers of freedom, but foreign interference had harmed our national unity. Today, as we are the masters of our own destiny, it is a blessing of the blood of those heroic martyrs and the strength of those warriors who have recorded deeds of bravery in the pages of history.
We must realize that freedom is a great blessing from God (J), and showing gratitude for this blessing lies in its protection and in strengthening national unity. If we become united among ourselves, then preventing foreign conspiracies will be easily possible. Educating the future generation in the light of knowledge and wisdom is a shared responsibility of us all. Steps must be taken for the advancement of education and training so that our youth have the ability to combat the challenges of the era.
The contribution of every individual is important for the prosperity of this homeland. Whether a farmer, a laborer, a scholar, or a writer, each one is an important pillar in the series of building this country. Relying on our country's products and freeing ourselves from foreign imports is the first step toward economic independence. Therefore, it is necessary that we support our domestic industries and make efforts to stand on our own feet.
2819.left:
Love for the homeland is a part of faith; therefore, every Afghan should not shy away from any sacrifice for the development of their country. History is witness that Afghans have never bowed their heads before oppression and tyranny, and this is the great pride of our people.
The conclusion is that independence is not only political freedom, but it is the path to a nation's dignity, honor, and progress. We must accelerate our movement toward the prosperity of our country by preserving this freedom. In the shadow of unity, we can take our place among the other developed nations of the world and lead our country to the highest heights of honor and pride.
May God (SWT) keep our beloved country forever prosperous and safe from all kinds of misfortunes. Amen, O Lord of the Worlds.

Kabul, 1349 Shamsi year
Compromise: In the event of a thief or murderer being caught red-handed, the implementation of strict measures by the government regarding saboteurs, in light of the government's decision that authorizes the taking of any kind of measures in the path of strengthening national security, is worthy of the full support of the people. However, despite this, it is worth noting that the implementation of these actions within the framework of the law is what causes the prevention of social chaos.
Question: What is the opinion of the Minister of Justice of Afghanistan regarding these recent decisions?
Answer: The Minister of Justice, in line with the declaration published by the government, has stated that the protection of the people's rights is the primary duty of the state and no weakness will be tolerated in this regard. The welcome of these steps by the government from the people is a sign of their intelligence.
Section: The reaction of the people regarding the formation of a special committee by the government is considered an important step for strengthening the country's security. The duty of this committee is to investigate those who are involved in various criminal incidents. The rule of law is essential for the progress of any society and no tolerance should be shown in this regard.
Note: For further clarification of this matter, discussions have been held with the government spokesperson, which will be published in the next issue.
2820.left:
In this regard, the Minister of Justice said during his remarks: "The foundation of our law lies in ensuring the security of the people. Anyone who commits actions against the law must be handed over to the clutches of the law. The government is obligated to protect the lives, property, and honor of the people."
This decision has been met with a warm welcome by the people throughout the country. According to a group of Kabul residents: "We fully support this step by the government and hope that this process will be implemented rapidly across the whole country."
In conclusion, it is worth mentioning that the increase in coordination between the government's security agencies has led to these successes. The Ministry of Interior has stated in this regard that they are working day and night to strengthen the security of the society.
However, it is worth noting that security measures alone are not enough to solve the problems of society; rather, the government's efforts in the fields of education, economy, and job opportunities are also commendable.
This report was prepared by a reporter for the Kabul newspaper.

Over the past few years, such rumors have spread everywhere in our country that have rooted fear and anxiety in the hearts of common people. Although these rumors had been on people's tongues for a long time, they have recently taken a form that has preoccupied everyone's thoughts. People say that the conditions of our country are changing, and every day new events occur that have deep impacts on the country's economic and social life.

Along with this, in some areas, the living conditions of the people are becoming harder day by day, which has become a cause of people's dissatisfaction. This is not just a matter of economic problems, but people also have complaints regarding the lack of justice and fairness. In such circumstances, it is the government's responsibility to pay attention to these problems of the people and take practical steps to solve them, because public trust is an important pillar for the survival of any government. Winning the hearts of the people is not done just by making promises, but lies in practical actions and the resolution of people's problems.
2826.left:
In conclusion, it must be said that the solution to all these problems is for government officials to establish close relations with the people and create an organized policy to hear their problems. Maintaining security in every part of the country, the rule of law, and ensuring justice and fairness are what the people expect from the government. If the government takes serious steps in this direction, it is believed that the people's concerns will be removed and the country will take steps toward progress and prosperity.

Furthermore, promoting knowledge and education and providing suitable conditions for the education of youth are vital for the future of any country. If we want not to fall behind in competition with the international community, we must use our resources properly and ensure that every Afghan takes a part in the reconstruction of the country. Hoping for the day when songs of happiness will be heard in every village and home of our dear country and the carpet of misery will be rolled up.

2827.right:
Introduction
For Zardozi
Just as this series has been started in our magazine for the advancement of the art of Zardozi, this section also considers the historical background of this art, the rights of workers, and the issue of promoting this art as an important matter, which is considered a major step toward artistic and literary development at our national level.
In this regard, there is a felt need for research and precise, comprehensive studies on artistic and literary affairs, so that the views and experiences of scholars, artists, and experts in this field can be utilized as a vital resource, ensuring that the art of Zardozi—a historical and valuable art—receives special attention as a lasting heritage for the new generation.
Furthermore, it is necessary to mention the efforts made by certain individuals and institutions during past eras to promote and develop this art, which saved it from decline; their contribution in this regard is significant.
Ultimately, this magazine is a step that serves as an important and valuable resource for increasing the knowledge of art and culture enthusiasts and historians, and it will be used as a guide for future parts of this series to expand their information.
2827.left:
About the art of Zardozi
In the light of justice
For the sake of territorial level development and the strengthening of justice, it is necessary to consider a legal framework in this art sector to protect workers and their rights, so that alongside the growth and development of this art, the lives of the workers remain protected from all kinds of problems.
As a part of England's history, the growth of this art is closely related to their industrial revolution, during which these artistic activities became the focus of special attention and were used as an important tool for the development of this art.
The art of Zardozi is essentially known as an artistic skill that is a sign of human elegance, precision, and patience, and recognizing the value of the work of every kind of artistic hand in this field is an important issue.
In conclusion, for the preservation of this art, there is a visible need for the unity of all relevant organizations, and especially the artists, and the coordination of their efforts, so that they can fulfill their historical responsibility in protecting this national heritage in the best way.

Islamic Conquests
After centuries, Sultan Saladin Ayyubi entered Palestine in triumph after breaking the chains of oppression of the Christian forces. Facing thousands of soldiers of the last group of the Christian kingdom, the Sultan skillfully decided to break the morale of the Christian troops for the conquest of Jerusalem. When the Christian army attacked the Muslims in Palestine with great cruelty, Sultan Saladin Ayyubi called his soldiers to Jihad to defend the holy religion of Islam. A fierce and bloody war began between Sultan Saladin Ayyubi's armies and the Christian soldiers for the liberation of Jerusalem. Sultan Saladin Ayyubi prayed for his soldiers for the help of Almighty Allah and the victory of Islam. Sultan Saladin Ayyubi, along with his army, prepared for the battle against the strong walls of the Christian soldiers for the conquest of Jerusalem. In response to the atrocities of the Christian soldiers, Sultan Saladin Ayyubi aroused the spirit of sacrifice and faith of Islam in his soldiers. As a result of the Muslims' war, after the Christian soldiers were defeated within their walls, Sultan Saladin Ayyubi successfully conquered the city of Jerusalem and ended Christian rule.

2829.right:
Mirat al-Najat and the situation of the Muslims of Palestine: In an issue of Mirat al-Najat, an article regarding the situation of the Muslims of Palestine has been published which is a matter of great regret and sorrow, and we too, with great remorse, quote some sentences here for the sake of admonition regarding the dire situation of the Muslims in that place that is ongoing:
"Since the time when the bad habit of the Christians' behavior began in this land, since that day, not a single Muslim in this country has remained safe from the behavior of the Christians of that place; at every step, they receive harm and suffering from the Christians, and oppression is committed against them by the Christians.
Since that time, the situation of the Muslims of Palestine has been very bad and regrettable. When they became distressed by the atrocities of the Christians, they sought help from the Caliph of Islam and voiced their cry to him, but they (the Caliphs) were in a state where they themselves were embroiled in various problems and were not prepared to help the Muslims.
These atrocities of the Christians continued until other Muslims of the Islamic world thought about this matter and started working to help the Muslims of Palestine. This situation of the Palestinians is very painful, that in their own homes they see signs of oppression from the Christians, all kinds of life facilities are blocked for them, and there is no security for their lives and property.
While the life of the Muslims of Palestine has become very difficult due to the oppression of the Christians, they are requesting help from the Islamic world, and it is necessary for them (the Islamic world) to take serious steps in this regard, so that this bad situation of the Muslims of Palestine ends and they are given the opportunity for a life of honor and security."
2829.left:
First page - 42
In this article, it is also stated that this series of atrocities by Christians against Muslims is still ongoing, and in the absence of Muslim unity, these atrocities are increasing day by day. For the Muslims of Palestine, the unity of the Islamic world and raising a voice to help them is very essential.
The author adds that efforts at an international level are needed to defend the rights of the Palestinian people, so that Christians may desist from these evil acts of theirs and give Muslims the opportunity to obtain their rights.
This article has been published at a time when Muslims in other parts of the world are also concerned about the situation in Palestine and are emphasizing the importance of the unity of the Islamic world for their salvation.
In conclusion, the author requests all Muslims to help the oppressed Muslims of Palestine and to make every effort to defend their rights, because it is the religious and moral duty of every Muslim to support their oppressed brothers.
In the same way, this story of the Muslims of Palestine is an important reminder for all Muslims regarding the lesson to be learned and the necessity of unity, and it shows that until Muslims become united, they will not be safe from the atrocities of their enemies.

A Word
We put this word into the ears of the new generation as advice, for it is necessary that they understand the value of this matter. This new generation, which is seeking to acquire education today from every direction on the path of learning and upbringing, must set a specific purpose for their acquisition of education. If their purpose for education is merely worldly gain and obtaining government positions, then instead of benefit, this education will be harmful to their people and their nation, because in the absence of a specific principle of religion and faith, education is like a power that, if used in the wrong way, becomes a cause of destruction for society. Therefore, we tell the new generation that education is necessary, but along with education, the spirit of serving one’s religion and national consciousness is also essential.
2830.left: Our hope for this educational work is that this new generation spends their life acquiring such an education that, as a result, a new spirit is born in the lives of Muslims. For this, it is necessary that education should be for a specific purpose; if education is only to stand with hands folded for a position in offices, then God save us from such an education. Our hope is that this new generation acquires such knowledge for the service of their nation that they stand like a strong wall in service of their religion and in opposition to the enemies of their nation, because today, more than the need for knowledge, there is a need for morality and religious consciousness, from which today's new generation is far removed, so it is necessary to strive in this path.

Petals on the path of life

On the path of life, we face many hardships and sufferings, but behind every difficulty, a ray of relief is hidden. This is the true path of life: that we stand on our own feet. These efforts of the people of Pashtunkhwa for independence and the preservation of their culture are worthy of praise. Every young person must get to work for the progress of their homeland. No matter how many obstacles there are on the path of love and affection, we must not give up. In this journey of life, we are all one and are working for a common goal. True stories depict the lives of those people who seek a path to success in the midst of adversity. It is necessary for us to benefit from the speeches of our elders and lay a strong foundation for our future. Let us maintain a bond of love and affection with every petal of our homeland. 2832.right:
Magazine "Afghan", dated March 9, 1920

Announcement for the owners of freedom

Imagine that history is moving through a very strange and fascinating stage of humanity. In this era, such a great transformation has occurred that all colonialism and tyranny on the face of the earth is trembling. The uprisings of the people of India, the national movements of the people of Turkey, and the passion in the hearts of Afghans themselves to quench the thirst for independence—amidst all these major events, Afghans appear more determined than ever to decide their own fate. Here the question arises, how can these rays of hope for the freedom of nations reach their goal?

The answer lies in the unity of the nation and the full understanding and honesty of its leaders. Nations that have fallen victim to neglect in the face of the conspiracies and deceit of their enemies along the complex paths of their history are heading toward decline. But a zealous nation like the Afghans, which has never bowed its head to any tyrant in its history, must defend its rights in the light of knowledge. Against the enemies of our nation, the greatest weapon is the path of learning and strengthening unity. In every region of the country, the fire of love for independence must be kept burning in the minds of the new generation, so that future generations may be more powerful than before in protecting the country.
2832.left:
And in its light, continue towards independence.

Letters of the homeland after the announcement of Fayaz
In the discourse of the time towards innovation in life, we must admit that after winning freedom, preserving it is very difficult. The changes in world conditions are proceeding rapidly. In these circumstances, we must raise our country's economy, culture, and level of education. Today, we fight not only with the power of the gun, but also with the power of knowledge and art. It is the duty of every Afghan to take their part in the path of building the homeland. Whether it be the pen, the shovel, or the shedding of sweat in the field of work.

We must have unity among ourselves and not be deceived by the deceit and hypocrisy of outsiders. In the path of defending the homeland, we must not withhold any kind of sacrifice. History will judge the men of our time as to whether we were truthful in our path or not.

In conclusion, this is a note for all patriots that the prosperity of the country depends on the courage of every individual.

(Editorial by Toofan Sahib)

In this, the province's administration was also falling into decline under the control of the provincial government. He would do this work in the province by adding to the misery. The ordinary people did not find them.
When we were traveling outside of India, the people of other countries used to taunt us. They would say that these people are slaves themselves, and they have come to ensure our slavery. When we saw this situation, it became clear to us that a life of slavery is worse than death.
The strange thing is that on one side, people from other countries were shouting, and on the other side, the behavior of the British was not good towards us. The British had only kept us for their own protection. I observed that the British did not respect the Indian soldiers at all. We were sent to almost every battlefield for the British, and the British were behind us. I observed that the British were committing great injustices against us.

Even if my own brother stands in the way of my freedom, I will face him too. When the war started, I had to face my own brother on the battlefield while fighting for the freedom of India.

Indians will free India with their own strength.

A great example of this is that when a brigade consisting of three thousand soldiers was formed, despite the command, we had Muslims, Hindus, and Sikhs all together. There was complete freedom of belief. Muslims would pray in the congregation. Hindus would go to the temple, and Sikhs would perform their worship in the Gurdwaras. Yet, we were all bound by a thread of unity and harmony. At that time, there was love for the homeland. We all fought on the battlefield. The blood of our brothers—Hindus, Muslims, and Sikhs—flowed for the freedom of our homeland.
The British spread this false propaganda that they are the well-wishers of Indians, but there is no unity among Indians. Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose proved this claim to be the opposite, showing that all Indians are complete. It is the British who have created these divisions. Industrial Committee and Industry

Respected Farm Doctor: Mr. Meherban, questions regarding the major crops of our province—such as rice, maize, millet, tea, and others—are rarely raised, and attention is not given to them. Instead, all their attention is focused on rice crops.

This type of work, no matter how beneficial or interesting it may not be, does not serve the basic needs of the province. Full utilization of the experiences of the local growers would be beneficial.

In these settled areas, agricultural experiments could become effective if a proper record of them were kept.

The current fund! It is often said that the government does not have enough money for industrial development. If calculated, no one can deny the need for financial resources for the province's development. However, the pace of development depends on how financial resources are prepared. Since the expenses on loans for the sake of, for the sake of industrial development are significantly higher, it is obvious that there is a flaw in the government's policy. The expenses on the police and government systems are increasing, and they have no proportion to the improvement of the province. Justice demands that out of agriculture and industry, from which 2.5 million in revenue is obtained, only 500,000 rupees are spent on them; more funds could be spent. For this reason, the claim that there are no funds for industry is completely baseless.

Recently, the government has taken the responsibility of investing two hundred thousand rupees in the Takht-i-Bahi sugar and distillery factory, while it is difficult for the government to find even four million rupees upon which the people's livelihood depends.

The voice of my heart for the unity and life of the Pashtuns of my homeland.

Memoir: I saw with my own eyes that everyone in my homeland is making efforts in their own way for the unity and betterment of the Pashtuns; I, too, am writing this little bit from the bottom of my heart on this path, hoping that with this small effort of mine, the spirit of unity, brotherhood, and understanding of one's rights will increase even further among the Pashtuns of my homeland.

Whenever I contemplate the state of the Pashtuns, a kind of regret arises in my heart, because the main reason for the decline and humiliation of our nation is that we do not appreciate each other, and instead of unity, we have chosen the path of discord. If we want to live in this world with our heads held high, we must all work with one voice, one thought, and one accord for the progress of our nation and homeland. The sacred command of our religion is also that Muslims are brothers, but unfortunately, we do not act upon this. The differences that exist between us become a cause for the enemy's gain and weaken us.

I call upon all my Pashtun brothers and sisters to come, let us join hands in unity today and gird our loins for the development of our homeland; let us take steps to build our future in the light of knowledge and wisdom, and ensure that our future generation will live in freedom and dignity.

2859.right: In the first place, there is a need for such unity and consensus to emerge for the Pashtun nation that it finds a way to escape from the yoke of the ruling nation's slavery, because the Pashtun nation is grappling with many difficulties due to the oppression and aggression of the ruling nation. For the Pashtun nation, the way to escape this catastrophe is through such a strong national uprising and unity that, by the grace of God Almighty, will be the way to liberation from the chains of this despotic system. If we gather our self-sacrificing and brave Pashtuns together, then breaking the chains of this slavery will be very easy. For the Pashtun nation, there is a need for an organized and purposeful struggle to achieve its rights and independence, in which the participation of every Pashtun is essential, and one must be prepared for every kind of sacrifice on the path of this struggle, because the future honor and independence of the Pashtun nation is hidden in the success of this struggle.
2859.left: In conclusion, for the Pashtun nation, there is a need for such national leadership for this kind of unity and struggle that understands the pain of the Pashtun nation and takes steps to solve their problems. These Pashtuns of ours, who live in mountains and deserts, are in need of such leadership that leads them towards a bright future. Therefore, this national uprising is an important step not only for the liberation of the Pashtun nation but for all oppressed nations. If we lose this opportunity, then there will be no way left for the awakening and unity of the Pashtun nation. So let us all become united and gather under a single national agenda to defend our land and our honor, which is the first step towards our prosperity and success.

Issue number 13

Year 1329

Announcement of the Kabul Mushaira!

Announcement of the Kabul Mushaira! This Mushaira (poetry symposium) is being organized with the support of the Ministry of Education's Department of Information and Culture so that literary scholars and poets may gather in Kabul. The purpose of this Mushaira is the development of the Pashto language and literature and the encouragement of the new generation. This Mushaira will be a major path for the elevation of the Pashto language.

Conditions for participating in the Mushaira:
1. Every poet must submit one or two of their poems, which should be in various Pashto language forms (Ghazal, Qasida, Rubai, etc.), to the Mushaira committee.
2. The subject of the poems must be in accordance with the demands of the time and the needs of society.
3. Participants must submit their poems to the Ministry of Education by the specified date.
4. At the end, awards will be given for the best poems by the leadership of the Mushaira.

This Mushaira is an important step for the flourishing of Pashto literature and it is expected to have significant results for the advancement of the Pashto language.

As for the tax, because the product is almost equal to one person's daily wage, if all these are put together, then this handicraft product is very expensive for customers. If the producer says that people have money to buy these goods, then the state itself is to blame for this high cost. Because on every type of goods, when they are transported from one place to another, various taxes are levied, the burden of which then falls on the shoulders of the laborer and the craftsman. Because this is the situation, it has resulted in the destruction of domestic handicrafts.

A few more points for craftsmen: -
To improve the country's industry, these two things are necessary: -
First: For the arrangement of money, the creation of a capital field (credit/advance) (at a reasonable interest rate). (Second) Learning about new and modern tools and equipment, the establishment of shops and markets for the sale of goods, and the attention of the country's people to improve these goods.

Before these necessary things for industry and trade are accomplished, it is necessary to educate the people of the country about this, and for this purpose, a few pamphlets of knowledge should be printed, in which the benefits of industry and trade and their methods are explained in detail.

This is the result of the efforts of a poor person, which he has done in the service of his country. The obstacles in this path include the lack of knowledge, the lack of understanding of the art, the need for improvement of industrial equipment, and the lack of government cooperation. Now, because the level of people's knowledge is very low, it is the state's job to form a committee for the development of this industry, which includes people with knowledge and expertise in this work, in order to arrange for the encouragement of the people and their financial assistance. This will be very beneficial for the country's industry and economy and will pave the way for the country's development.

I am writing an article for the Pakhtun on Saturday. This Saturday became Sunday night; now I am writing this for myself, and I am putting aside the work that I was supposed to do. After all, the Pakhtun newspaper is the sole representative of the entire Pakhtun nation. It is published under the auspices of Bacha Khan's movement. Paper will run out, printing presses will age, but the issue of writings will never end.

Pashtunwali!

It seems that for the sake of the honor and pride of Pashtunwali of our poor and oppressed Pashtuns, as in recent times in some provinces, due to a series of misunderstandings by some people and the ignorance of others, they were burning in the fire of their own enmities one after another and losing their lives and property in this path, something happened that hurt the heart of every pained Pashtun, and this was considered a major obstacle to the unity and cohesion of the Pashtuns for a long time, and these enmities also had a very bad effect on the culture and civilization of the Pashtuns in a very bad way, and because of this, such senseless wars and problems were always created by some ignorant people, which could be considered a major obstacle in the path of the country's progress and prosperity.

Looking at this, a number of the country's intellectuals and well-wishing leaders of the Pashtun nation decided that a step should be taken to eliminate these senseless and useless enmities, and to spread a message of peace, brotherhood, and unity among the people of this society, and in this path, they proposed the creation of a joint Pashtun Jirga and discussions in this Jirga to solve these problems, which in itself is considered a very important and historical step in the path of Pashtun unity.

Recently, during the Jirga formed for the purpose of Pashtun unity and ending enmities, Pashtun leaders began efforts to resolve their differences with great sincerity, and their efforts were a matter of joy and hope for all those who sought benefits in the unity of the Pashtun nation, and during this Jirga, with the participation of a number of Pashtun tribal leaders, youth, and scholars, it was decided to prevent further enmities and, alongside this, to hold discussions within the framework of knowledge and logic regarding all the problems that exist among the Pashtuns.
2898.left:
which opens a new chapter of unity and brotherhood for the Pashtuns, and alongside efforts for the success of this Jirga, all Pashtuns were requested to choose the path of Jirga and dialogue to resolve their differences, to work together for the prosperity of their nation and country, and this Jirga is remembered as the beginning of a new page in Pashtun history that carries the good tidings of peace and brotherhood.

It was emphasized by all participants of the Jirga that everyone must strive for the unity and solidarity of Pashtuns, create an atmosphere of love and brotherhood instead of hostility and hatred, and be ready to make any sacrifice in this path; it is the duty of all Pashtuns to stand in one rank for the honor and pride of their nation, to resist the conspiracies of outsiders, and in this path, the weapon of knowledge and wisdom is considered the most important weapon.

In the end, members of the Jirga requested all Pashtuns to take steps towards knowledge and education for the development of their regions, to pay full attention to the education and upbringing of their children as it is the best investment for their future, and the Jirga pledged to create special plans for the spread of education and knowledge for the future of the Pashtun nation.

The fact that the Ministry of Education, in order to encourage all kinds of innovations and scientific efforts in the path of serving the homeland, has started a scientific and literary publication named "Watan" in the series of education publications for the development of the Pashto language, is a step that is welcomed by Afghanistan's intellectuals in the field of education and literature, and there is no doubt that it will play a major role in enlightening the minds of the country's children.

Writing is a matter that has an unparalleled role in shedding scientific light on the human mind. If we look at our past historical assets, a large part of our scientific wealth has remained preserved in these written forms; therefore, now that the Ministry of Education has taken this initiative, it is incumbent upon every Afghan to struggle for the prosperity of the country in this path through the language of their pen.

Since science is the foundation of the development of every society, the "Watan" publication will be able to lay a good foundation for the dissemination of education at the national level, and for our young generation, it will be a source that will quench their thirst for learning science and literature. Anyone who wants to take a step in this path should pave the way for the future of the country by means of their pen.
2904.left:
Carrying out all kinds of scientific and literary efforts for the purpose of serving the country is our common duty, and in this path, the role of "Watan" publication is commendable. I hope that this publication becomes an effective tool for promoting knowledge among Afghans and plays a positive role in raising the scientific level of the country.

In the end, it must be said that such publications for strengthening the pen are extremely necessary for enlightening society, and in the series of educational publications, we hope for its increase so that it keeps the torch of knowledge lit in every region of our country.

2905.right:
Pashtun

13 March 1920

(Issue One)

"Pashtun"

I intend to form such an association of Pashtuns that will strive for their knowledge and the betterment of their lives, and become a strong voice for the preservation of Pashtun history and culture. I know that there are many difficulties for this task, but my heart is full for the progress of my nation and I will not hesitate to make any kind of sacrifice in this path. In this magazine, we will present articles, news, and analyses for the education of our Pashtun brothers, the improvement of their economic situation, and the provision of social justice. I request all Pashtuns to support this nationalist movement, so that we can save our homeland from all kinds of colonialism and backwardness. May God be our helper in this pure goal and may He make us successful in our efforts for the unity and glory of the Pashtun nation.
2905.left:
Personal notes:

Recently, some friends have expressed the wish that a structured path be paved for the youth of our nation so they can organize their lives in a scientific and practical manner. A major reason for the laziness and negligence of our youth is the lack of a structured guide. In this magazine, we strive to fill those gaps and find ways for the awakening of the Pashtun nation that will lead to the prosperity of our nation in the future.

It is worth mentioning that these efforts of ours are solely for the unity and independence of the Pashtuns, and we do not in any way want to use this magazine against anyone. We want to strengthen love, brotherhood, and the sense of living as a single nation among our brothers. We hope that every Pashtun realizes their responsibility in this path and participates in our material and spiritual support.

Receive it regularly, this is the Pashtun magazine.

The "Pashtun" administration
