2908.right:
Editorial

The Pashtun

12 April 1920 AD

The desire of my heart and Pashtunkhwa

My heart desires to meet with the people of Pashtunkhwa in a place where there is an opportunity to express the desires of my heart. I earnestly request the people of Pashtunkhwa to work together in unity to preserve their language, their culture, their history, and their honor. Today, there are many among us who sow the seeds of discord among our people for their own selfish interests and destroy our unity. I call upon our leaders, our youth, our writers, and our intellectuals to come, let us adopt the path of unity and take steps on the path of knowledge and enlightenment to serve our nation. It is necessary for us to raise the cry of unity and brotherhood in our schools, in our gatherings, and in our newspapers. If we become united, no power can resist us. This is the voice of my heart; this is my message of love for every Pashtun who burns with love for their land and their nation. I pray to God Almighty to bless our unity and give us the ability to serve our nation.

2909.right:
Peshawar: -
Ever since the experts of Peshawar city learned that the government intends to implement a water pipeline system in the city streets, waves of happiness have emerged in the hearts of the people, because the city residents have been facing severe difficulties for a long time due to the shortage of clean drinking water. With the start of this project, not only will the people's health improve, but there will also be a great improvement in the cleanliness of the city. This step by the government is being welcomed by the general public, and the residents of this region are praying from the bottom of their hearts for the success of this government action. They are hopeful that this project will be completed in a very short time, and people will benefit from this major facility.

On the other hand, according to some sources, the survey of various areas of the city for this project has been completed, and the work of laying water pipelines will begin practically very soon. It is said that the government has allocated a special budget for this project so that there will be no obstacles in the distribution of the water pipeline network in all parts of the city. The city residents consider such steps taken by the government to be in the interest of the people and express hope that other facilities will also be provided to them in the future. It is worth noting that due to the lack of a water pipeline system in Peshawar, people had long relied on well water, and water contamination was also a major problem in some areas. However, it is now expected that with the completion of this new project, these problems will be completely solved, and clean drinking water will reach the people easily. This was a long-standing desire of the people of the region which is now on the verge of being fulfilled, and the people seem very happy with this step of the government. In this regard, the elders and youth of the region have expressed their happiness and demanded the immediate implementation of this project.

2910.right:
Kabul Magazine, a Pashto publication

In the court of the servant of the servant, the beloved friend, Allah (SWT)

In the early days of Kabul magazine's publication, the question in the readers' minds was what this magazine would be for, and what is its purpose?

It was made clear in the first issue of Kabul magazine that the goal of this magazine is to work for science, knowledge, and the progress of society. This magazine will help in raising the level of people's knowledge. Our aim is to spread the light of knowledge in this country and for our compatriots to become familiar with new sciences and knowledge. Useful content regarding history, literature, politics, and social issues will be published in this magazine. We hope that our compatriots will expand their knowledge by reading this magazine and contribute to the progress of society.

Furthermore, writings by the country's renowned writers and scholars are also published in the magazine, from which readers will benefit greatly. We strive to make each issue more interesting and useful than the previous one. We hope that all compatriots will help us in strengthening this magazine and send us their valuable writings and opinions. The series of magazine publications will continue in the same way, and we will make tireless efforts in this path to serve the people of our country.

Note: Along with the above content, information regarding the Ministry of Education's new educational plans has also been provided in this issue. The goal of these plans is to improve the quality of the country's schools and to provide a foundation for better education for the new generation. Besides this, several articles regarding the improvement of the country's economic situation have also been published.

2911.right:
Tamasha, the third part of the Afghan publications series
Politics
From the beginning of the nineteenth century to the beginning of the twentieth, the political winds that have blown across this land, as a result of them, the owners of our land never thought that in order to free themselves from the tricks of others, it was necessary to take steps in the way of acquiring the knowledge and art of the new era. Instead of taking steps for progress in the path of science and technology, they burned in the fire of their internal enmities and misfortunes, and instead of thinking about the power and strength of their homeland, all their thoughts and attention were focused on how to find ways for their brother's ruin and disgrace. The pages of history testify that during these centuries, very great storms have come upon our land, but our rulers and authorities of that time, instead of taking steps for the awakening and unity of their nation, made such deals with foreigners to strengthen their own power that it became the cause of placing chains of slavery around their necks. This is such a painful and instructive story that reading it makes every Afghan bleed from the heart. Today, when we talk about creating a new Afghan, our goal is to learn from these past mistakes and lay the foundation stone of a society in which the breath of science, knowledge, unity, and harmony is blown. Our goal is to emerge from the darkness of past centuries and take steps towards the light, because there is no other way for the survival of a nation except for science and knowledge, and it is our collective responsibility to use all our strength to achieve this goal.

2912.right:
Politics Letter
In the first issue, we had started the Politics Letter like this:
Two months have passed, the newspaper owners do not remember what to do?
So many days have passed and there is no sign of the newspaper owners; it seems that all their talk is tied to troublemakers, and the newspaper owners benefit from people talking against each other, or it seems they have no intention of living together with these people, as they use their newspapers to distance people's hearts from one another and then take advantage of this distance. May God save our nation from these newspaper owners who prepare the means for the nation's destruction for their own gain. This is not politics; this is the means of destroying one's own nation. A newspaper is meant for people's knowledge and the prosperity of the nation, not for its destruction. If a newspaper is for the knowledge of the nation, then it is a very good thing, but if it is for hostility and division of the nation, then it is a cause of great misfortune for the owners of such newspapers. May God save this nation from the evil of such people. A newspaper that is for the benefit of the nation is the greatest means for the nation's knowledge, but if the owners of such a newspaper do not strive for the unity of the nation, then such a newspaper will never be a cause for the nation's prosperity. Therefore, newspaper owners should refrain from such actions and write in their newspapers for the unity and prosperity of the nation.
This publication is for enlightening our nation, and our point with these words is that newspaper owners should become aware of their responsibility because the knowledge of the nation is in the hands of the newspapers. If newspapers move in the right direction, then the nation will also move in the right direction, and if newspapers move in the wrong direction, then the nation will also head toward destruction. Therefore, newspaper owners have a very great responsibility in this, and they should use this responsibility in such a way that it leads to the nation's prosperity and progress, not its destruction. This shows how important a newspaper is and how big a role the newspaper owners have in this work. So, this newspaper is for the awakening of the nation and their knowledge; therefore, the newspaper owners should make full use of it and work for their nation. It is everyone's duty to bring the light of knowledge to their nation, and full effort is required from everyone in this task. Thus, our advice to the newspaper owners is to write such articles in their newspapers that lead to the awakening and knowledge of the nation.

2914.right:
Results of the parliamentary elections
With the passing of the parliamentary election days, new representatives were elected by the people's vote for the benefit of the people:
On this day of electing 9 members for the public good, according to the election results, the following individuals were selected as parliamentary representatives:
1- With the election of 24 members from the 24 districts of Kabul city, work began on this day for a series of reforms at the provincial level for the people of Kabul.
2- With the election of 34 members from Nangarhar, the path was paved for the people's demands; as a result of these elections, the people's trust in the provincial council members increased.
3- With the election of 21 members from Kandahar, the people's demands regarding the strengthening of security and order in the province were taken into account.
4- With the election of 15 members from Herat, the foundation for a strong administration was laid with the aim of solving the people's problems.
5- With the election of 13 members from Mazar-e-Sharif, the groundwork for work was prepared for the people of the northern region based on a specific policy; these individuals were chosen according to the people's will.
From all these decisions, it is clear that: (1) The people have paid full attention to electing their representatives, (2) compared to the previous round of elections, the participation of the people has increased significantly, (3) under the guidance of the Kabul Municipality, the transparency of the election process is in everyone's mind, (4) with the election of regional members, the path to improving the quality of people's lives has been paved, (5) all these individuals are trustworthy people to the public, and with their success, a new era has begun at the national level.
We view these elections as a success.

In these elections, people from every corner of the city of Kabul participated with full consensus and unity, as a result of which 24 people were chosen by the people of Kabul to assist the Kabul government in managing the city's affairs and in the work of the welfare and improvement of the people.

Question: What is the status of the homeland in a person's life and what has Islam ordained regarding the love of the homeland?
Answer: In reality, the homeland is a great bastion for preserving a person's honor, dignity, and human integrity, and the love of the homeland is embedded in the nature of every human being.
However, the sacred religion of Islam has considered the love of the homeland a part of faith, and this is a Sharia ruling, because Islam has taught self-sacrifice, devotion, and Jihad in the defense of the homeland.

Question: What are the human body's organs used for?
Answer: Every organ of the human body has been created for its own specific function, which is utilized in the affairs of life.

Question: What are the signs of Allah Almighty's power?
Answer: The signs of Allah Almighty's power are clearly visible in the height of the heavens, the vastness of the earth, the alternation of night and day, and in the structure of animals, plants, and human beings themselves, all of which are the work of a wise and omnipotent God.
2924.left:
What can you say about the situation of the Muslims of India and the need for their education?
Answer: India is a historical center of Muslims, where an Islamic government was established for a long time, but now their condition is regrettable due to a lack of education and a kind of negligence.
Today, the Muslims of India are compelled to strive in their religious education alongside modern sciences, so as to defend their historical prestige and their national identity.
Their lagging behind in the field of education is the biggest cause of their decline, so it is necessary for every Muslim to use their full potential in acquiring knowledge.

Commentary
The month of Saur of the year 1299 of Afghan [calendar]
(Continued from last month)

Among those people during the era of Ghazi Amir Habibullah Khan who had the permission to speak with great courage regarding the deterioration of the country's situation at that very time, one of them was a high-ranking official of the court of the then-King of Afghanistan, who had presented his views on the state of the country in a way that no trace of fear or anxiety could be seen in it. Regarding the internal situation of the country and the poverty and helplessness of the people, he writes:

In reality, there has been a significant change in the level of knowledge and science of our country's people, and to raise the standard of living of the people, it is necessary that serious measures be taken for the development of modern education and new learning in the country. Because due to illiteracy and the lack of education, most of the people of the country are facing a situation where no hope can be held for the future. Likewise, regarding the economic situation of the country, we can say that poverty and hardship are widespread among the people, and without the attention of government officials, solving this problem seems impossible.

According to this writer, the only way for the progress of the country is to introduce new reforms and establish justice, and the administration of affairs should be carried forward by considering the will and demands of the people.
2926.left:
In the end, for the prosperity of the country and the well-being of the people, he has demanded the establishment of such a system in which the rights of all citizens are protected and the rule of law is the same for everyone. He writes:

"If we want to compete with other nations and find a place for ourselves in the world, then we must not spare any efforts in reforming the internal affairs of our country. The rule of law, the establishment of justice, and raising the level of people's education are the fundamental tasks that we need for the country's progress. Apart from this, any other kind of action will only be a waste of time and will not bring about any positive change in the country's destiny."

These writings of the author present a clear picture of the social and political situation of that time, which points out the spirit of demand for change among the intellectuals of the country.

There are many people who work day and night for the development of their language, and I also want to be a part of this work.
In this way, I hope that these writings will be a source of benefit for our people and they will be able to use them in various aspects of their lives.
2932.left:
When we talk about such works, we understand their importance. In reality, every work that is done to awaken our nation and raise their mental level is worthy of appreciation. In order for our nation to be successful in the affairs of their lives, it is necessary that efforts be made in a comprehensive manner.
But if we organize our life affairs properly, then the chance of success is much higher. For the progress of a society, the dissemination of knowledge and wisdom is the most important issue. Because if people are knowledgeable, they will be able to find solutions to their problems and make better decisions for their future.
I hope from God Almighty that He gives us the strength so that we can always remain steadfast on this path to serve our nation and make efforts to preserve our language and culture.

2934.right:
14 April 1920
Pashtun
Although the inhabitants of the great Khyber Pass are Pashtuns by origin and lineage, their way of life is different from that of many other Pashtuns. If one turns the pages of history regarding the people of the Khyber Pass, it becomes clear that they have lived within the framework of their tribal customs for many centuries. Among them, the Jirga system is very strong, and the decision of the elders has the status of law for resolving any dispute. The people of the Khyber Pass are generally known for their hospitality; if someone comes to their home, they serve them to the best of their ability. The Pashto language in their mouths is very sweet and unique in its flavor. If other aspects of their culture and life are examined, there is no doubt about their bravery and courage. They are always ready to defend their land and stand to the death in protecting their honor. For the progress of the Pashtun, there is a need for the light of knowledge in their lives; if they are given the opportunity for education, they can do many things for their nation and homeland. In my opinion, the merits of their social life are worthy of being extended to other parts of Pashtunkhwa. It is the duty of all Pashtuns to hold the hands of their fellow brothers and pave the way for unity. May God grant that these Pashtun brothers of ours are always prosperous in their lives and keep the name of their nation high.

1- With the publication of this year's first issue of Pashtun, there is a need to form an association in Pashtunkhwa in which all the leaders of the region and the Pashtun nation strive for progress.

The Azadi publication conveys the voice of oppressed and subjugated people to the world with complete honesty and truthfulness. We struggle against oppression with the power of our pens, and we hope to improve the social and political state of society in the light of truth and reality. 2943.right: Regarding the civilization of Muslims in the past, and their knowledge and many other things of theirs, we know that these people had surpassed other nations of the world in every art and every science. At a time when many nations of the modern world were spending their nights in the dark shadows of ignorance, the followers of this blessed religion of Islam, through their scientific achievements, laid the foundation for the civilization and scientific progress of the modern world, which even today people from many countries of the world remember and take pride in. For the sake of this scientific and civilizational progress, for those who seek information in this regard, we have started this series so that our nation can find information about their ancestors and their scientific achievements.

The goal of this effort of ours is that we once again find our place in the world by regaining our scientific and civilizational heritage. The search for truth

Useful lessons

An era of ignorance, an enemy of progress and education, an enemy of the scholars of education, an enemy of truth, failing in the search for truth (hear)


It is a very important and noteworthy truth of our time in world literature that throughout our lives we have learned that our past scholars kept the lamps of knowledge and enlightenment burning at the cost of their lives in the path of education and the search for truth. If we think a little about this, we realize that the difficult stage our country is in today, where we lie in the dark shadows of discord, is due to the lack of the light and education of our past scholars. Today, the country's children and youth are walking on a path to acquire knowledge and education that has largely failed in finding the truth. The search for knowledge and truth is a task that takes on a new and fresh form in every era as time passes. It is fitting for us to follow in the footsteps of our past leaders and place the lamps of the light of education in the hands of our youth so that the dark night of our country may turn into light and we may succeed in the search for truth in every field. It is a fact that the progress of a country without education is impossible, so we must make tireless efforts in this path.

Question?

What have I done that I have become so distressed at the hands of my enemies that I have no idea about anything? I submit this request to the owner of Sitara Afghan that for God's sake, show me a way of salvation. I can no longer bear the oppression and force of my enemies, what should I do?

Answer:

The answer to your above question:

1- Do not be proud of your enemy, because it is very necessary to use patience and tolerance in the face of the enemy's deceit and trickery.

2- Do not be proud of your enemies, and in the face of your enemies, secretly and openly use such strategy and prudence that they remain stuck in their path for you, and in the face of their every kind of oppression and force, find such patience and steadfastness in yourself that you are not broken by their every kind of oppression, and in this calamity and problem of yours, rely on your Lord and seek refuge in God's court from the evil of your enemies, and pray to God for salvation from their evil so that God may grant you salvation from the oppression of your enemies and put blessings in your affairs, and keep you safe from the evil of your enemies.
2946.left:
Question?

I am very troubled by my friends. Among my own friends, there are people who have friendship and camaraderie with me, but in secret, they wish for my bad and are engaged in all kinds of measures for my destruction and ruin. So, what should I do against such people to get rid of them?

Answer:

This is the answer to your question:

1- Be very careful in choosing your friends and companions, do not trust everyone, and in your friendship, join with people who use truthfulness and loyalty and are honest in their friendship.

2- If you suspect such people among your friends, then keep yourself secretly away from them, do not share your secrets with them, be very careful and precise in your dealings with them, and in your relationships with them, choose a path so that they cannot cause you harm.

2949.right:
Ethics

Now again in this article, for the sake of advice and lessons for this article of mine, I am writing the following few points; I hope you will keep these points in mind:

1- Always treat everyone with a gentle temperament and good manners, because the possessor of good manners has respect everywhere.
2- Respect your elders and teachers greatly, because the secret of success in life is hidden in their prayers and advice.
3- Choose the path of honesty and truthfulness in every task, because Allah (Jal Jalaluhu) loves the truthful and the trustworthy.
4- Do not be lazy in prayer, because prayer is the pillar of religion and protects man from sins.
5- Value your time greatly, and do not waste your time on aimless talk and tasks, because time is a sword; if you do not strike with it, it will strike you.
6- Help your other friends in good deeds, and forbid them from bad deeds.
7- Protect yourself from bad friends, because the company of bad friends ruins a person's character.
8- Always strive to learn knowledge, because knowledge is the torch of a human's life.
9- Have love for your homeland and your nation, and always be ready to serve them.
10- Start every task with planning and thought, so that you do not face regret.

Author: Shah Alam Khan

1322 Hijri Qamari
2949.left:
In addition to this, the following points are also very important:

1- Serving one's parents is the duty of everyone, and in their pleasure lies the pleasure of Allah.
2- Helping the poor and the needy, financially and personally, is a high rank of humanity.
3- Strictly refrain from telling lies, because lying is the mother of all kinds of evil.
4- Abstaining from backbiting and speaking ill of others is a trait of a believer.
5- In every situation, use patience and tolerance, and be content with Allah's will in times of hardship.
6- Keeping one's home and environment clean is a part of faith.
7- Use gentleness in speech and firm determination in action.
8- Do not transgress against anyone's rights, and give everyone's right to its rightful owner.
9- Seeking knowledge is mandatory for every Muslim male and female.
10- Always strive against your ego (nafs) so that you remain protected from the whispers of Satan.

In the end, I pray to Almighty God that He grants us all the ability to become people of good character and aligns our lives in the light of the blessed religion of Islam. Amen.

2951.right:
In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
Introduction:
In previous issues, we made a brief note regarding the start of this series, and in its continuation, we also discussed contemporary cultural and literary movements of the country in another segment. In this series, we have endeavored to shed light on those aspects of our country's contemporary history that may be on the verge of being forgotten with the passage of time, or that have been deliberately discussed by certain circles in a way that carries the color of myths and imaginations rather than facts. This effort of ours, which we have considered in this approach for the sake of the national interests of the country and the unraveling of historical facts, has led us to draw the attention of our readers to some valuable writings and documented events of this phase of our language and literature. In this sequence, we have also mentioned the writings and works of a number of the country's scholars and cultural figures who have continued their actions for the growth and development of the Pashto language and literature. Our hope is that this series can serve as a credible source for those young people and researchers who want to understand the contemporary history, culture, and literature of their country accurately. This series, which is presented to readers in a new format with each issue, strives to shed light on the past events of the country and its cultural values in a truthful manner. In this path, we look forward to the opinions, suggestions, and criticisms of all our scholars, researchers, and language enthusiasts, so that they may help in strengthening and improving the quality of this series. We recognize this task that we have undertaken as a great responsibility and hope that with the passage of time, we will not fail in this path of serving our language. In the end, we thank all those who cooperate with us in this area and, by submitting their writings and research, strive to further enrich this work.

2952.right:
19
By the grace and bounty of Allah Almighty, due to the negligence of Muslims in their own religious and worldly affairs, they had fallen into pits of destruction and ruin. For the sake of their reform and welfare, a series of initiatives has begun everywhere to establish schools for Islamic sciences and worldly arts, print books, and publish newspapers, which is a place of happiness and hope for every zealous and truth-loving Muslim. However, along with this, it is a matter of great regret that in our country, there is great negligence regarding the correctness of language and the originality of vocabulary for printing books. Because the words written in our newspapers and books are very far from and altered from their original words, it is necessary—so that the originality of the language and the correctness of the vocabulary may remain forever—that for every book that is printed, a person should be appointed who is knowledgeable about the principles of language and the rules of vocabulary, and who carefully examines its words and phrases so that the path of the current people may align with the path of the past, and the spread of incorrect words may be prevented. Because the corruption of language is a major cause of the corruption of a nation, it is necessary to pay great attention and thought to this matter, and for every new writing, a standard dictionary for the rules of the language should be prepared so that it is easy for readers to read it and they can fully understand its meaning, because without the correctness of the language, there is no benefit in compiling books for science and art.
For the sciences that have been designated for the youth to learn, it is very essential to first learn the correctness of the language in order to understand their meaning and purpose, and then striving to learn every science in its light is a great path for them. Therefore, for this purpose, efforts should be initiated in the form of an organized group for the reform of the language, and a permanent column should be dedicated to the correction of vocabulary in newspapers and magazines.
This is a very necessary matter for a nation that is seeking a path for its own civilization, because the protection of language and culture serves as a shield for the survival of a free nation.
(From a special article for The Afghan)

2953.right:
Understanding Education
Regarding the honor and etiquette of knowledge, there is such knowledge and etiquette that is a status and rank of humanity's nobility, greatness, honor, and value, which has been granted to the son of Adam by God Almighty, through which he recognized everything by the power of knowledge. And in the knowledge and recognition of God Almighty Himself, many conveniences were created for him. Therefore, it is necessary that we make great efforts in the path of acquiring knowledge and do not spare ourselves from great struggle and hard work in the path of acquiring knowledge. Because seeking knowledge is an obligation for every Muslim, as the leader of the world, may God bless him and grant him peace, has said: "Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim." So, it is necessary for us to make great efforts for education in our lives and work very hard in acquiring knowledge so that it may be useful for our lives in both worlds, and by the grace of God Almighty, we may find many ways for success and honor in both worlds, so that through this, the pleasure and happiness of God Almighty may be in every work of our lives, so that our life may be successful in this world and the hereafter.

2956.right: At this time, when an effort is being made to awaken the Afghan nation for the purpose of uniting material and spiritual forces from all sides to strengthen the powers of the kingdom, and every writer is taking steps to serve the nation to the best of their ability, I too have considered myself a participant in this national service and have petitioned in the court of His Majesty for the publication of the "Afghan" newspaper, and by the grace of his approval, I have been granted permission by the order of the ministry to accelerate the printing work at the Kabul press for the publication of this newspaper. This newspaper will be for the progress of the nation and for stating the truths regarding the country's political and social issues. I hope from all those whose hearts beat with love for the country that they will use their pens to enrich this newspaper and awaken the consciousness of the people through their writings to achieve national goals. The path of service to the country is very long, and the assistance of every person for this task can be a source of great success. It is hoped that by reading the first issue of this newspaper, everyone will realize their national responsibility and will not spare their efforts for the success of this newspaper. From now on, this newspaper will be printed weekly from the Kabul press and will be placed in the hands of the people.
2956.left: For the sake of the country's progress and the development of scientific and literary affairs, this newspaper operates under the attention of the Ministry of Education. It is our endeavor to present accurate and precise information regarding every subject to the people. In particular, this newspaper will have a special place for the training of the youth and the strengthening of their national spirit. Any writer who wishes to publish their writing in this newspaper can come to our office and submit their writing through the management. Information regarding past events, the situations in other countries, and cultural affairs is also written on the pages of the newspaper. The opinion of the people is of great value to us, and we strive to move the newspaper forward according to their wishes. In this delicate phase of the country, there is no other way than unity and accord, so the primary goal of this newspaper is also unity among the people. May God grant us success on the path to the country's prosperity and grant us the success to bring benefit to the nation through this newspaper. Whatever is for the benefit of the nation will find a place in this newspaper, and the pen will not be used inappropriately for anyone's personal interests. This newspaper belongs to the entire nation and is published for the well-being of the nation.

Independent India

The rays of the shining sun of independence have now spread everywhere, and the hearts of India's freedom fighters have also shone with joy. After a long time of demand and struggle, now the rays of the sun of freedom are seen in every corner of India. It is a matter of pride for every Indian that they are now enjoying a free life and have emerged from the dark shadows of slavery. In this new era of freedom, every human being has been given the opportunity to showcase their talents and contribute to the progress of their country. This is a new chapter in the history of India, where the entire nation has united around the slogan of freedom. This path to freedom was not easy, but this success was achieved through sacrifices and perseverance. Now, every citizen of India is doing their part in building the future of their country and is taking steps towards progress with the hope of a developed India.

It is a matter of shame for every self-respecting Muslim that this is the state of our educational institutions. It is the responsibility of every individual to work for this according to their means and to strive for such unity that, as a result, this institution may once again begin its work as a center for the glory of Islam and the Muslims.

2966.right:
Subject: A welcome interview and message of national unity on the occasion of the Herat people's New Year.

Beginning: A special message was published to congratulate the people of Herat on the arrival of the New Year. In this message, the people are asked to join hands in unity and harmony. We must all stand united against the conspiracies of the country's enemies. The freedom of our land is our collective responsibility, and we must stand for its protection until our last breath.

The path to progress lies in the light of knowledge and education. Every family must provide their children with the opportunity to learn religious and modern sciences. The history of our ancestors is full of sacrifices and dedication. We are currently at a stage where the world's conditions are changing, and we must take steps in accordance with the demands of the time.
2966.left:
For the prosperity of the country, words alone are not enough; action and work are needed. At the suggestion of the people of Herat, it was decided to establish an association for the youth that will work to meet their intellectual and social needs. This association will be free from all kinds of prejudice and will pave the way for the flourishing of the talents of the youth of Herat.

All those who feel the pain of the country are requested to support this national endeavor. We must leave our differences behind and take action for a common goal, which is the prosperity and development of the homeland. With the help of Allah (SWT) and the blessing of our national unity, Herat and all of Afghanistan will take great steps on the path of progress. By the end of the year, the work on all projects that have been started must be properly completed for the service of the nation.

2969.right:
In the life of a Pashtun (in their own)

Let us read these following words and sentences regarding the life of a Pashtun carefully:

A Pashtun in their life is as deeply immersed in the love of their homeland as fish are immersed in water; a Pashtun has become so self-forgetful in the love of the homeland that they have paid no attention at all to their other life affairs. In this path, the Pashtun has endured such hardships that their equal would not be found in the history of the world. A Pashtun loves their elders just as a son loves his father. A Pashtun is themselves such a nation that they are famous throughout the world for their bravery and honor. Compared to other nations of the world, a Pashtun shines in the field of honor and bravery just as stars shine in the dark night. A Pashtun is ready to make every sacrifice for the prosperity and happiness of their nation. In the being of a Pashtun, there is such a strength and power that they stand like a mountain against the enemy. A Pashtun remains steadfast until death in the protection of their religion and culture and never bows their head before oppression and tyranny. A Pashtun believes that the purpose of life is God's pleasure and support of the oppressed. A Pashtun knows the value of every moment of their life and strives to spend their life in the path of goodness and brotherhood. A Pashtun has recorded such achievements in the pages of their history that they will live forever.
2969.left:
Afghan Identity

In grief, the heart is as if there is mourning for someone's death in a village, but a Pashtun does not drown so much in the sorrows of the world; a Pashtun knows that life is the name of a struggle, he does not break before his enemy nor does he give up his goal, the path of a Pashtun's life is like a bright star that shows the way of truth in the darkness of oppression, who will tell the story of the burning and pain of a Pashtun's heart? The stories of a Pashtun's honor and pride will be written in golden lines in history, he is looked upon with respect all over the world for his bravery, a Pashtun himself possesses a quality that is much higher and more glorious compared to other nations, he fulfills his promises and sacrifices everything for his homeland, the life of a Pashtun is like a garden whose flowers are colored with the hues of faith and Islam, he acts as a shield not only for his own nation but for all the oppressed, a Pashtun himself is such a nation that in every stage of history has recorded its name with pride, the scent of honor comes from every moment of his life and signs of sacrifice are seen in his every step, throughout his life a Pashtun has supported truth and justice, he has never remained silent before a tyrant and has fought for his rights to the point of death, a Pashtun himself is such a nation that is considered a symbol of exaltation and honor in the world.

The Ministry's Decision on the Writing
Regarding the administrative affairs of this issue of Pashtun, the efforts of the editor of Pashtun newspaper, and a number of government decisions concerning the actions that were considered for the printing and distribution of Pashtun newspaper, it was decided by the Ministry that Pashtun newspaper must continue its activities within the framework of the law and must fully comply with the country's laws regarding its publications.
It has been explicitly stated by the Ministry in this regard that Pashtun newspaper has the potential to play a constructive role in spreading information and knowledge for its readers in the country, but it must exercise extreme caution in selecting its publications and should not publish anything that is detrimental to national unity and the country's stability.
Furthermore, the Ministry has stated that the owner of the Pashtun newspaper’s license and its officials must organize their affairs while keeping this government decision in mind, and if any signs of violation of the law are observed in the future, the government will be forced to take necessary steps in accordance with the law.
It is also mentioned in this announcement by the Ministry that Pashtun newspaper is an important tool for educating the people and for the cultural development of the country, and it should strive to state the truth and facts during its activities.
This decision by the Ministry is considered a new chapter for Pashtun newspaper, and they are requested to make beneficial use of this opportunity and work for the interests of the country's people.

2983.right:
June 1, 1946

Afghan

(Introduction)

A new and bright phase is beginning in the history of Afghanistan. This phase came at a time when the talk of freedom and progress was on everyone's tongue in the balance of the life of nations. The changes that have occurred in our country over the past few years are indicative of the fact that our nation has chosen a path of new life for its future. This is, in reality, the result of those struggles that our ancestors waged for the honor and pride of their country. Now it is our duty to pursue this path with strong resolve and action.

The political and economic changes that have taken place in our country in recent years have resulted in a great tremor in the thoughts of the people. These thoughts demand a new order, an order in which the light of justice, equality, and freedom is spread. Every citizen of our nation is waiting for a new dawn today, a dawn that announces the end of dark nights, and the melody of a new life is being heard everywhere. The Afghan nation no longer needs anyone else to determine its destiny, because the blood of sacrifice and courage flows in the veins of this nation.
2983.left:
There are many obstacles on this path, but the courage of our nation has the ability to break every kind of obstacle. Progress in the field of education, innovations in the sector of industry and agriculture, and the protection of rights within the framework of justice are things that form our priorities. It is a fact that besides possessing natural resources, our country also has capital in the form of brave youth. These same youth are the architects of this nation's future.

It is the duty of our journalists and writers to publish these demands and hopes of the nation in a sacred manner. History will record our today's efforts in its pages. If our steps are strong, then the destination of success is not far. This journey requires patience, tolerance, and unity. We must never become victims of despair, because the light of hope has the ability to break every kind of darkness.

2985.right: At this time, a very significant development regarding Eastern affairs emerged in London, which was that a party had formed in Britain that advocates for the freedom of India. They are opponents of Britain's policy regarding Eastern affairs and they say that Britain's policy regarding the East is full of mistakes. If these people were to join the British government, it is possible that there could be a change in policy regarding Eastern affairs, or at the very least, a glimmer of new thinking might emerge in British policy. This news caught the attention of many people in India, and a new hope was born in their hearts. In any case, we must be very cautious about this matter and understand that it takes a long time for such things to become reality in politics, and often the outcome of such matters is not what we expect. Regardless, this is something that serves as a great hope for those seeking India's freedom, and we must keep an eye on the progress of this matter. Britain's policy regarding India is at a very delicate stage, and we must proceed with our affairs very carefully. As a nation, we must unite for our freedom and must fight firmly for our goals.
2985.left: Urgent Government: A piece of news that is about to reach the provisional government of India regarding the ministers' policies and the policies of the British. In the ministers' view, the demand for freedom in India is a reality that no one can hide nor suppress by force. Although the British are trying to silence this voice, they have not succeeded in doing so. Another aspect of the council of ministers is that they are struggling for the rights of the people of India on a global scale. They have established relations with various countries of the world in order to gain international support for India's independence. The provisional government has announced that they will fight for the rights of the people of India until the last breath and will never bow their heads before colonialism. According to the ministers, India's freedom is the right of every Indian citizen and they will offer every kind of sacrifice to achieve this right. Their determination has breathed new life into the people of India and has further illuminated the path of their struggle for freedom.

2991.right:
In Life - 12 - In Life

Do you know that this method of learning, which is called modern education, has become the cause of humanity's destruction and the decline of morality? Does this new education, called civilization, not sow the seeds of such a poisonous and dangerous thought in the brains of humans that it causes the destruction of their human and moral feelings?

In reality, the education of our current era is such a dark dungeon of imitation and aimless following of others that the soul and thought of the new generation are imprisoned within it. Through this education, we have not only lost our national values but have become slaves to foreigners in our own home. Instead of cultivating a free and thoughtful human, this education creates a creature that neither cares for itself nor has the ability to worry about the future of its nation. They are only in search of memorizing those books which are written in a very useless and dry manner and do not plant any kind of true knowledge in the minds of the students.

We must wake up from this negligence and adopt a path of education that aligns with our culture, language, and national history. If we want to regain our lost greatness once again, it is necessary that instead of the current material and soulless education, we establish an educational system that plays a constructive role in building human character and plants the love of truth and reality within their inner self.
2991.left:
Translation:

In reality, education is an essential thing for human life. Education is a foundation in the human heart for greatness, progress on the path of truth, and for all kinds of difficulties. But we must remember that education should not just be the memorization of books, but rather it should be used as a tool for the human intellect and for true understanding in all aspects of life.

If we think about the principles of past education, we will realize that a specific method was used for education at that time. In it, students were trained under the supervision of a teacher, which was of great importance for the strengthening of their minds and the expansion of their thinking. But in current education, there are so many aimless people who are only thinking about obtaining degrees for the sake of learning, and instead of fulfilling their duties, they are only in search of earning a salary.

In the present time, what is called education, which uses an educational method that is only for material gain instead of moral and national values, is a great danger for the destruction of society. In order for us to brighten our future, we must understand well that it is necessary to use methods for education that have an abundance of ethics, patriotism, and human love. In order to save ourselves from this threat of education, we must start work on a new thought and a new curriculum in all our educational institutions, in which there is no place for the imitation of the West instead of Islamic and national values.

3011.right:
Question: Do Muslim sects have the right to call Muslims by the name of Muslims? If they hold such a belief about another Muslim that he is a disbeliever, then what is the ruling on it?
Answer: In the Book of Allah (SWT) and the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (PBUH), there are very clear instructions regarding the excommunication (takfir) of Muslims, killing them, or creating division among Muslims and regarding their rights. Therefore, anyone who speaks about a Muslim in a way that casts him out of the circle of Islam is, in reality, violating the rulings of Sharia and attempting to sow discord among Muslims. It is, therefore, the responsibility of Muslims to adopt a path of brotherhood and love toward one another and to protect themselves from the words of such instigators of strife.
3011.left:
Question: What is your opinion regarding the revival of the Islamic Caliphate concerning the Muslims of India? Is it beneficial for the Muslims, or does it create new problems among the Muslims?
Answer: Regarding the subject of the revival of the Caliphate concerning the Muslims of India, our opinion is that every group should strive to implement the rulings of Islam according to their own conditions and situation. The concept of the Caliphate in Islamic history was for unity and preserving the cohesion of the Islamic Ummah, not for creating new divisions among the Muslims. Therefore, the Muslims of India should proceed with their affairs while considering their own circumstances and conditions, and work for the unity of the Muslims.

3012.right:
Decline and the letter on the decline of Muslims

In 1920 AD, the government's attention was drawn to the backwardness of Muslims through the publication of a type of letter by a government official regarding the causes of the decline of Muslims. This letter, which is considered part of the government's policy at that time, creates a kind of awareness among Muslims about progress, education, and the principles of modern life. The content of this letter clearly calls for the education, unity, and strengthening of national thinking among Muslims. According to this document, the main reasons for the decline of Muslims are shown to be ignorance, lack of unity, and staying away from modern sciences. This letter is in fact a kind of call to awakening, written for the unity of Muslims and for them to obtain their rights in the political and social arena.
3012.left:
First, the demand for education

God leads those in whose destiny there is good towards knowledge. In the present era, without acquiring knowledge, no step can be taken in the progress of the nation. We see how far other nations of the world have advanced by the power of knowledge, yet Muslims still remain in ignorance. We must make great efforts for the education of our children. Without knowledge, our honor and dignity have no value. In Islam, the acquisition of knowledge is mandatory, and it is necessary for every Muslim to take a step towards knowledge at every stage of their life. The only path to the survival and progress of our nation is education. In the end, I call upon all Muslims to send their children to schools and not be lazy in any way in acquiring knowledge.
(Author: As a Muslim)

3- Are other languages also published in it?
Answer: Yes, in case of necessity, it is also written in other languages, but its foundation is in Pashto.

Answer: Pashtun newspaper is published from the center of Kabul.

Answer: Yes, if the people's writings align with the publication's policy, we publish them gladly.
7- Is anything written about Islamic and national issues in this?
Answer: Yes, our publication's priority is the protection of Islamic values and national interests.
3014.left:
13 --- Pashtun
Adultery and the Adulterer
Recently, the question has arisen in the minds of some people: what is the punishment for an adulterer?
Answer: In Islamic Sharia, very strict and firm laws have been established for adultery.
1- If the adulterer is married (is Muhsan), their punishment is stoning (being pelted with stones).
2- If the adulterer is not married (is Ghair-Muhsan), their punishment is one hundred lashes.
3- How many witnesses are needed to prove adultery?
Answer: To prove adultery, four just and truthful witnesses are necessary who have seen this act with their own eyes.
4- If someone falsely accuses another of adultery, what is their punishment?
Answer: The punishment for Qadhf (falsely accusing someone) is eighty lashes, and until the accuser proves to be truthful in their claim, their testimony will not be accepted again.
5- Do you have any recommendations for the prevention of adultery?
Answer: For the prevention of adultery, firstly, the role of the family is very important; secondly, the moral education of society; and thirdly, the strict implementation of the law.

3018.right:
18
The Struggle of Jamiat Ulema-e-Hind
Signs of awakening in the hearts of the scholars of India, upon joining the call for India's freedom, became more apparent than in other classes of India. The courageous steps taken by the scholars paved the way for shaking the foundations of British rule in India. As leaders of the Muslims, the scholars felt the need for an organization that would prepare all the citizens of India uniformly for the war of independence. To implement this, it was decided to convene a meeting of scholars, and for this purpose, a conference of prominent scholars of India was called. In it, the scholars reached a consensus regarding the formation of a united front of the servants of Islam, and as a result, the foundation of the "Jamiat Ulema-e-Hind" organization was laid. This organization became known as a strong bastion for the Muslims of India to confront the British colonial system.
3018.left:

A famous statement
At a time when news of the possibility of differences arising regarding the strategy of the Ulama for the freedom of India was being published by groups of new scholars and intellectuals, in accordance with the statement of a famous and knowledgeable person who says: "There is a need for a group to remove the obstacles in the path of knowledge that will strive for the unity of Muslims and the protection of national interests, so that unity may come among Muslims through this."
This statement was recognized as an important tool for the consensus of Muslims in accordance with Islamic teachings. Understanding the importance of this, the Ulama emphasized in their writings and speeches that the unity of the Ulama is very necessary for the unity of Muslims, and as a result, a significant change will come about in the conditions of the Muslims of India.
The British government is using all kinds of measures against such a group in India to prevent the unity of the Ulama.

3019.right:
Issue 18 - First Year

Dervishes and their way (Tariqa)

Initially, it is necessary to shed some light on this subject, because it has a very close connection with the faith and beliefs of the people of India and the Muslims. In India, there is a large and ancient history of dervishes and their groups.

For what purpose did these dervishes come?

Among the dervishes, there are also those who have sacrificed themselves for the service of Islam. Among these groups, there are also some who have used the name of religion to deceive people and for their own personal gain. Therefore, people must have this knowledge to distinguish between the original and true dervishes and those who use this sacred name only for their own benefit.

This issue itself is very significant for the pure religion of Islam. In India, the main goal of these activities of the dervishes was to strengthen the original spirit of religion among the people and to spread divine love. However, with the passage of time, some changes occurred, and certain actions in the name of religion created doubts among the people.

So in conclusion, it is necessary for every Muslim to act in accordance with the principles of Islam in the actions of their dervishes and never move away from the principles of their religion and faith due to the bad deeds of such people.
3019.left:
18 - First Year

Pashtun

Like the people of India, religion and spirituality hold a very high place in Pashtun culture and society. However, this spirituality should not be in such a way that it hinders people's knowledge and the progress of life. We must understand that true religion is not in conflict with reason and logic.

In Pashtun society, often such people rise in the name of dervishes who take undue advantage of the simplicity of the people. They instill beliefs in the hearts of the people that neither align with the original teachings of Islam nor serve any purpose for the progress of life. This is a great tool for the enemies of the Pashtuns to keep our people trapped in ignorance and in superstitions in the name of religion.

It is necessary for a Pashtun to inform himself about the original and true nature of his religion. The religion of Islam is a religion of knowledge and wisdom. Those who try to create obstacles to the advancement of science are in reality hostile to the spirit of Islam. We must understand that a true dervish is one who calls people toward knowledge, action, and human ethics, not one who involves them in ignorant beliefs and superstitions.

In conclusion, it is hoped that all Pashtuns, for the sake of preserving their religion and culture, will protect themselves from anyone who, in the name of religion, creates obstacles to the progress of our people. The path to our prosperity lies only in the original teachings of Islam, the light of knowledge, and the bravery and human ethics of our ancestors.

(Riayatullah Khattak)

3024.right:
Question: In proof of a claim that a claimant makes for a right and the defendant denies it, what proof is upon the claimant according to Sharia?
Answer: According to Sharia, there are two types of proof for the claimant: one by way of testimony and the other by way of confession. If the claimant brings two just witnesses to prove his claim, then despite the defendant's denial, the claimant's claim will be proven before the judge. If the claimant cannot bring witnesses, then an oath will be demanded from the defendant. If the defendant takes the oath, the claimant's claim is void, and if he does not take the oath, the claimant's claim is proven, because refusing to take an oath is in the status of a confession.
Question: If a person asks another person for money and the defendant refuses to pay, in what situation will the judge ask the defendant to take an oath?
Answer: When the claimant cannot bring witnesses to prove his claim, the judge, according to the ruling of Sharia, tells the defendant to either bring witnesses or take an oath. If he takes the oath, the claimant's claim is terminated; and if he refuses to take the oath, then after his refusal, it is mandatory for the judge to rule in favor of the claimant and order the defendant to pay the right, because taking an oath is a great responsibility for the defendant, and after refusal, the claimant's right is proven.
3024.left:
Question: If a man claims the property of another man and the defendant denies having that property in his possession, is it lawful under Sharia for the person who denies having the property in his possession to take an oath or not?
Answer: Yes, it is lawful for the defendant to take an oath in the case where the claimant has no witnesses, because the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said "Al-yaminu 'ala man ankhar," meaning the oath is upon the one who denies. If the defendant takes an oath at the time of denial, then there is no ruling for him to pay the property, but it is necessary for him to fear Allah Almighty, and if the right truly belongs to the claimant, he should hand over that property to the claimant because taking a false oath carries a very severe punishment for the hereafter.
Question: If a man has no proof to establish his right and requests an oath from the defendant, is this an act against Sharia?
Answer: No, this is not against Sharia; rather, in the case where there is no proof, it is the right of the claimant to demand an oath from the defendant. If the defendant takes the oath, the claim is finished, and if he does not take it, the right is established for the claimant. This is a great way of Sharia justice so that people's rights are not lost, and this is the demand of justice.

3033.right:
Copying regarding the newspaper

When we were asked the question whether copying the newspaper is permissible or not, we answer this question by saying: If the newspaper owner has prohibited the copying of their newspaper, then copying it without their permission is not permissible according to Sharia. This is because the newspaper owner has spent money on it and the right to its profit belongs only to them. And if someone makes a copy against their will, it is an infringement (excess) upon their rights. And consuming a Muslim's right is not permissible. However, if the newspaper owner has personally given permission for copying, then there is no harm in it. Furthermore, if the newspaper is copied for a necessity that benefits the general public, then according to some scholars, in accordance with Sharia principles, there is room for it. But even then, it is necessary to be cautious and protect the rights of the newspaper owner.

Reference: Afghan Newspaper (Copy)
3033.left:
And in the same way, regarding the articles and news of the newspaper, we can say that the newspaper owner has worked very hard to publish it and has invested capital for its arrangement and management. So if someone publishes its contents elsewhere without his permission, then this is a waste of his rights. And in Islam, seizing someone else's hard work and benefiting from it without permission is not a good deed. Therefore, it is the duty of every Muslim to respect the rights of the newspaper and to abide by the Sharia rulings in the matter of copying it. If the newspaper owner is agreeable to the fact that its news can be copied elsewhere, then there is no problem. And if he is not satisfied with this, then copying it or using its materials is not permissible according to Sharia. It is necessary for the newspaper owner to write "(Copyright reserved)" or other such phrases in their newspapers so that people are aware of copying it. And in this way, everyone's right will be protected and we will also be saved from disagreements.

(Amin Atal)

Pashtuns are not merely speakers of one language, but a living nation that has sacrificed their lives throughout history to protect their land, honor, and dignity. Then in Kabul, among other conversations, I asked: what is the meaning of this—not bravery, but waiting for someone else to do something, assuming they will take action? They said that this is another path we are on, and we want to obtain our rights. I said that this is a sign of weakness. They replied, "No, this is considered a strategy." I then asked them, "If we continue on this path, what will happen to our future?" They said that God exists and He will make everything right. I said that God helps those who help themselves. By the pen of Mr. Shamsuddin
O Afghan youth! When will you awaken? When will you think about the prosperity and welfare of yourselves and your homeland? When will you stand in the ranks of other nations of the world in the light of knowledge and art? Think a little about what your ancestors did in the world by the power of knowledge! So let us gird our loins to acquire knowledge, save our homeland from the dark shadows of misery, and take steps toward a new life.

You see how rapidly the world is progressing. Every day new inventions and new knowledge emerge. Should we remain in this same state? Do we not have the right to live in honor and comfort like others? Of course we do. But this right is not gained by sitting idle and being thoughtless. This right is gained through knowledge, understanding, unity, and accord. Let us fulfill our responsibility toward the prosperity of our country by making a resolution today. Let us light the candles of knowledge in every home and play our part in eliminating the darkness of ignorance. Only in this way can the path to the salvation and glory of our homeland and people be found.

What kind of men are considered in terms of law? In this way, first of all, regarding the duty of humans, this duty has been determined for humans by means of the law. That every individual is recognized by their right and by means of the law, and if they stay within the limits of the law, then as a human, they fulfill this duty. But if someone transgresses from the law, they are not a human but rather like a disorder, and the law has also set certain restrictions for such people.

Now, if someone asks whether this matter regarding human duty is determined by law, or in other words, if the law truly recognizes a human as a human by means of a duty and their own right, then in this case, what is the decision regarding human duty? In response, we can say that by means of this duty, the law not only shows humans a way of life, but it is also a necessary thing for the protection of their own rights, and in this way, the law plays an important role in every aspect of human life. And if the law is implemented by a society, then such order will be created in the life of the society that will protect the rights of every human and everyone will live their life within the framework of the law.

In reality, law is something that lays the foundation of justice and fairness in human life. If someone violates this law, they are attempting to disturb the peace and tranquility of society. And in that case, the law takes strict and punishable measures against such people, so that others may learn a lesson from this and the peace of society remains preserved. Thus, in this way, the law is not just something regarding human duty, but is a fundamental component for the preservation of the entire system of human life.

O brothers in faith! In reality, when we think about the acquisition of knowledge, there are many types of knowledge that, due to ignorance, become a cause of destruction and ruin for humans. But knowledge is such a gift from God that through it, humans become distinguished and superior to other creatures. Because of knowledge, human intellect and thought are developed and expanded, and the path to success and perfection in life's affairs is revealed to them. In today's era, when we contemplate the importance of education, it is clear to everyone that education is one of the essential needs for every human being. Education changes a person's morals, character, and way of interacting with others for the better. Through knowledge, a person can distinguish between truth and falsehood and can easily make decisions between right and wrong in different areas of their life. Education is the foundation of a nation's progress and prosperity, and it is a ladder upon which, by climbing, one can reach the destinations of development and success. Because of knowledge, new thoughts emerge in the human mind, and one finds new ways and methods to solve life's problems. Therefore, in order for us to strive to create a society for our lives that has peace, tranquility, and progress, it is necessary for us to equip our children with knowledge and bring the light of knowledge to them.

3123.right:
What shall we do about this?
Education is not just like other studies; rather, education is a tool that is a fundamental and immutable path for progress and development at a global level. In the current era, education is the only means for the prosperity of a nation and the defense of their rights. Due to the lack of education in our society, we are facing immense problems in many areas, but for a young generation, this is a complex and difficult phase in the pursuit of obtaining education. There is a need for public awareness in society regarding the value and necessity of education. We must create an environment where education is easy for everyone, and no one is left deprived of the light of knowledge. The cooperation of every member of society is necessary for the promotion of education. If we want to be masters of a prosperous future, we must eliminate obstacles in the path of education and exert all our efforts in this regard. Education is not only limited to books and schools; rather, it is a process that directs human thought and actions toward the truth. If we look at the pages of history, we will see that every nation that has paid attention to education has succeeded and its name has remained throughout history.

3180.right:
On September 24, 1920, the Pashtun newspaper

News of the publication of the Pashtun newspaper in Kabul

With the announcement of the start of the publication of the Pashtun newspaper in Kabul, many esteemed and learned people of our nation welcomed this newspaper with their writings and opinions. Regarding the policy of our newspaper, for which we have a determination for the awakening of the Pashtun nation and their cultural development, many such writings have been received from the country's intellectuals which are considered a great hope for the country's progress. We respectfully thank our dear readers who have sent us their valuable opinions. This newspaper of ours will not just be a place for publishing news, but a special arena for spreading the message of Pashto literature and Pashtun unity. We hope that all Pashtuns will use their pens in this path to preserve their language and culture and further strengthen this scientific and national movement of ours. Our goal is to light the lamp of knowledge in every home and keep the spirit of unity and brotherhood alive in the hearts of the Pashtun nation. The content published in previous issues of this newspaper has highlighted the ways for the welfare and progress of the nation. In the end, we request all compatriots to help us by sending their advice and writings, because with the power of the nation's pen, we can brighten the future of our country.

3181.right:
In life
I was looking for something eternal regarding the opinions and views of scholars about the struggle of life. However, when I research the life circumstances and deeds of many people in this path, I always realize that this work, like a great history of life, is worth mentioning as an important history for society. Reflecting on the lives of such people and their deeds is truly of great value for the development of human thought. I want to think about creating a place regarding the life circumstances of such people that all people can benefit from. This is considered a very great service to society, and by understanding their life circumstances, we can find a good path for our future work, because the lives of scholars and experienced people are truly like a ship that finds its way through storms in the ocean of life and reaches its destination.

An important purpose of human life is to serve others. There are many people who have spent their entire lives in the path of solving the problems of the people of society and showing them the way to a better life. Such people are highly respected in society, and their memory lasts forever. Reflecting on the lives of such people gives a person the courage to do things for others during their own life that will lead to the progress of society. Truly, the real meaning of life is that a person spends their life in the service of others and brings about positive change in their lives.
3181.left: The more we understand the philosophy of life, the more our understanding of life's great goals and intentions increases. In this path, the opinions of scholars and thinkers are very valuable, because they have deep contact with every aspect of life and, based on their experiences, provide guidance that is useful for everyone's life. In order to understand the beauty of life and its deep meanings, it is necessary to reflect on the writings and words of such people. One important lesson of life is that a person should stand firm in the face of any kind of difficulty and never give up on their purpose. It is a sign of a wise person that they learn a new lesson from every event in life. In any case, courage and patience are very important for stepping on the path of life, and those who possess these qualities are always successful in their lives.

We are very grateful for their assistance in the printing and distribution of this journal, and we pray to God Almighty to accept their intention and effort in His presence, and to grant them even more success in this path.

To the partners
Look! Everyone knows that a lot of money is needed to print and distribute this journal. If, God forbid, the financial aid we receive were to stop, the work of printing and distributing this blessed journal would become very difficult. Therefore, we call upon all our partners with great humility and hope that they will continue their financial contributions for this journal, so that this journal can be published in the best possible way to instill love and affection for Islam and the national unity of Pakhtunkhwa in the hearts of the people, and that our national service continues in such a good manner. Their assistance will be a very great and valuable proof of how much they care about their national service. We hope that their assistance will never stop, and our national goal will be realized in the best way possible with their help. In return, there will be great rewards for them, and God Almighty will bless their services and open the way for goodness and prosperity in this world and the hereafter for them.

3183.right:
Introduction
Look! It has been several months since I wrote a few lines under the name of 'Faryad' (Cry) with the intention of addressing my brothers, but alas, in response to that, except for a few Pashto enthusiasts who understood the pain of my heart from the depths of their souls, no one else took the trouble to take a single step for the sake of Pashto. To tell the truth, in that writing, I had mentioned the shortcomings of the Pashto language and a few ways for its development, but unfortunately, this series of indifference from our own elders and writers towards this helpless and vulnerable language of Pashto reached such a level that now there is no room left for patience and tolerance in the narrowness of my heart. I do not want to cry out for the rights of Pashto anymore in front of such senseless people.

Brothers! I write for the survival of the Pashto language with drops of my heart's blood and I seek your attention.
3183.left:
In the end, I humbly request all Pashto enthusiasts to gird their loins to take a new and constructive step for the service of their language and to show readiness to endure all kinds of problems and difficulties in this path, because the future of the Pashto language is wrapped in this unity and in joint efforts. In the end, I pray for the well-being of all those who have taken a new and sincere step for the literary and cultural service of this scattered Pashto in the language of my pen, while hoping for a great success.

(Abdul Ghaffar)

3184.right:
Serving the Nation
- Like the people of Peshawar, it is self-evident to the Pashtun nation that, in every endeavor, they require the support of others, just as the people of Pakhtunkhwa do. To gain the support of others, it is necessary to foster unity and consensus among themselves. The Pashtun nation understands how essential it is to grasp the importance of consensus for gaining the support of others, and how beneficial it is for the Pashtun nation to tread the path of consensus. The Pashtun nation knows well that a lack of consensus leads to loss in every undertaking and results in failure. The Pashtun nation also knows that without consensus, there are no other paths for the Pashtun nation to gain the support of others, nor are there any other options available. The Pashtun nation knows that without consensus in unity with others, there is no path for progress for the Pashtun nation, nor are there any other paths to progress. It is known to the Pashtun nation that without consensus to gain the support of others, there is no path to honor for the Pashtun nation, nor are there other paths to honor. In short, without unity and consensus, there is no path for the Pashtun nation in any aspect of life other than difficulty and failure. The Pashtun nation knows that treading the path of consensus to find partners is an essential matter for the Pashtun nation, and walking the path of consensus is a major route to progress and honor for the Pashtun nation. Understanding the importance of consensus to find other partners is a significant matter for the Pashtun nation's progress and honor.

For the people of Pakhtunkhwa, understanding the importance of consensus is a significant matter, as it opens paths of progress and honor for the Pashtun nation. For the Pashtun nation, grasping this is a great step toward fostering unity and consensus, and for this, understanding this matter is a significant achievement for the Pashtun nation. In the absence of unity and consensus for the purpose of partnering with others, understanding this issue is a matter of great importance for the progress and honor of the Pashtun nation.

3186.right:
Question:
What are the rules for the beauty of words and meanings, and for the harmony of meter and rhyme in Pashto ghazal?
In Pashto language, it is necessary to give full consideration to the meter and rhyme of the poem to compose a ghazal. Pashto ghazal is very sweet and fluent in terms of its antiquity. Just as ghazal is a good medium for expressing emotions in other languages, it holds the same status in Pashto. For those who want to write ghazals in Pashto, it is necessary to acquire full mastery in the field of prosody (Aruz) and rhymes (Qawafi). For the fluency of Pashto ghazal, it is also necessary to use words in their proper place and choose such words that find a place in the heart of the listener. It is necessary to emphasize the continuity of meaning and the loftiness of thought in every hemistich of the ghazal. If we look at the history of Pashto ghazal, many great poets have greatly developed Pashto ghazal, and following their style can prove very useful for a new poet. In writing poetry, while maintaining exaggeration and a natural style, things should be said that reflect the sweetness of the Pashto language and its culture.
