Colorful imagination
(Women)
I silently say to myself in my heart that there is nothing else in this, it is just that if someone passes by on the road, then God forbid, they appear in a way that may God protect us from them, but it is not that they do not have a place in my heart. When I pass by on the road and my eyes fall on someone, that poor person is in fear, wondering who this is and what they are saying, because on this path everyone knows their own God and no one cares about anyone else. There are many such people who walk on this path and go about their business, some go to their families and some go to their businesses. In any case, this is another part of life where one must be careful.




This is a small example of the beginning of such things; there are many things in this that a person can think about and be amazed at the works of God. There are some people who spend their whole lives in these thoughts and never find the opportunity to enjoy life. I am also from this group; when I drown in these thoughts, I see nothing and I am not aware of what is happening around me. But when I come out of this thought, then everything looks different, like the morning sun rising from behind the mountain and illuminating the whole earth.
3196.left:
It seems that this is a place that has undergone many changes over time. People have changed, the land has changed, and even the ways of living have changed. Before, people were very simple and lived in their small joys, but now thoughts about everything have changed. I am also looking to see if these changes are beneficial or not. Some people say that progress is a good thing, but others say that this progress destroys the peace of the human heart.




But in my opinion, it all depends on the human being. If a person fixes their own way of living and is careful in their decisions, then these changes cannot cause any harm. In the time when people paid more attention to the worship of God and to their work, life was much more peaceful. Now we are in an era where everything passes by quickly, and we do not have time to think about our actions even for a moment.

3197.right:
Statement

It is hoped that this brief account will be a cause of interest for the observers of this new newspaper who are reading this new newspaper for the first time. This newspaper of ours, which is named "Afghan", is what we intend to publish. It is clear that, in accordance with the demands of the time, it will strive to publish all kinds of scientific and literary articles for the sake of increasing the knowledge of our countrymen and the progress of the homeland. In this path, we hope that all scholars, writers, and well-wishers of the homeland will honor us with their written contributions and provide us with their scientific light in the way of improving this newspaper. This is a small step for the prosperity of the country and the spread of knowledge, but we hope that with the passage of time, it will pave the way for a great service. The purpose of publishing this newspaper is to increase the knowledge of the common people alongside the spiritual and material progress of the country. If this effort of ours sows the seed of love for the homeland even in the heart of one person, then the reward for this fatigue of ours will be complete. In this newspaper, along with domestic and foreign news, information about scientific, historical, and social issues will also be published. It is hoped that with the support of our esteemed readers, this series will continue just like this and will continue its work for the prosperity of the homeland and the awakening of the people.

3198.right:
Education and fiction

There is no doubt that the layers of reality contain deep psychological knowledge within themselves, and although it is a major shortcoming in the modern tradition of fiction writing that it keeps the human heart engaged in a kind of aimless fantasy, it must still be said that fiction is a portrait of those interesting stories of life that are full of flavor and lessons, because the light of truth sometimes shines in such a narrow path of imagination that a person cannot separate it from himself in any way. When a person with a pen in hand brings his thoughts onto paper, he tries through those words to fulfill the desires that he has seen with closed eyes in his dreams and has used in every step he has taken in the field of life to gain knowledge and wisdom. Therefore, in this context, fiction is a bridge that leads a person to the highest levels of intellectual development.
3198.left: In addition to this, it must be said that if a story is based on a subject that finds a place in people's hearts in the form of true knowledge and experience, then it can become the greatest tool for the progress of society, because the human mind is influenced very quickly by listening to and reading stories, and this plays a major role in the development of his thinking. When we look at the stories of past times, it appears to us that the images of various aspects of life have been drawn with great precision in them. This is not only a means of passing time, but also a foundation for the development of human knowledge and insight. In conclusion, it must be said that story writing has the status of an art, in which the choice of every sentence and every word reveals the depth of the author's thought.

3199.right:
In previous issues, we published a short article about good and evil, and in its continuation, we presented a series of further points regarding these two contradictory forces of good and evil, in light of other indications emphasized from the perspective of rational and transmitted sciences, in the path of proving good and negating evil.

It seems that throughout human history, there have been many discussions among philosophers, sages, and religious scholars regarding these two contradictory forces, some of whom believe that at the foundation of the world's structure, two contradictory forces of good and evil existed from the beginning, which have crystallized in man with the passage of time.

On the other hand, followers of the school of Islamic mysticism and Sufism believe that the origin of the creation of the universe is based on good, and evil is only in the sense of the absence of good. Just as darkness means the absence of light, evil is also a state of being away from good, and man, by having his own free will, can choose the path of good or evil.

In the history of humanity, many such people have passed who have taken steps in the path of goodness and virtue that have lit lamps of light for society. These people, who have dedicated themselves to the path of truth and reality, always remain alive in the pages of history.

It is necessary for all of us to strive in spreading good and to protect ourselves from evil, so that we may become the cause of God's (J) pleasure and the well-being of society.

In my opinion, the great revolution that has taken place in the villages and homes of Pashtunkhwa today is in itself a very strong proof that Pashtuns have now awakened. In every village and every home, if there are any signs of knowledge and literacy, there is a sense of concern and thought regarding the state of their nation and the fate of their homeland. I myself sit among many of my friends, and whenever the topic of the progress of the Pashtun nation and their education and training comes up, everyone says in one voice: "The Pashtun has awakened!" But in my view, the meaning of this "awakening" is not just at the level of words, but rather the taking of steps in the field of action.

Recently, I was talking to a young man who was a resident of a remote area. From his conversation, it appeared to me that the series of Pashtun national awakening is not limited only to the cities, but has also reached the far-flung areas of mountains and valleys. He told me that now, even in our villages, a passion for reading books and newspapers has emerged, and people have realized that the root cause of our misfortune is the lack of knowledge.
3243.left: And it is that dark night of ignorance that has spread over our heads. I was very impressed by the words of this young man. When a nation understands why it is backward, then the way to work for its reform also becomes apparent to it. My belief is that this process of the Pashtun’s awakening will, God willing, be very rapid and moving in a positive direction, but on the condition that we carry forward our work with an organized program and a specific goal. Only feeling is not enough, rather action and seriousness are the great necessity of the time.

The beginning of a great and major event in world history
In the course of the start of the world war, the beginning of efforts to divide the world between world powers and to establish a new world order is mentioned. On one hand, the coalition of England, France, and Russia (Allied Powers), and on the other hand, Germany and the Ottoman Caliphate (Central Powers) were engaged in war to divide the world and secure their interests. In this context, discussions have been held regarding the situation of the Islamic world and the weakness of the Ottoman Caliphate. The conspiracies of England and other colonial powers against the Ottoman Caliphate and their efforts to change the map of the world are noted. In this article, a historical perspective of its time is presented regarding the atrocities of colonialism, the looting of Muslim lands, and the efforts to create a new political atmosphere on a global scale.

During the First World War, the goal of England and its allies was not only to defeat Germany, but controlling the resources of the Eastern world and dismantling the Islamic Caliphate were also among their main plans. The hidden face of their colonial objectives is revealed in the encouragement of the Arab revolt by the British. This article is considered a deep look at the role of the British and other powers in the arena of world politics as an important part of historical events, which was presented to readers in the magazine published at that time.
3264.left:
According to the British strategy, another part of dividing the world was that they wanted to create divisions among the regions of the Middle East, specifically among Islamic countries, and destroy their unity. The Sykes-Picot agreement between Britain and France is one of those secrets that played a major role in changing the map of the region. According to this agreement, the Ottoman Caliphate was divided among them, and each colonial power made plans to expand its influence in the region.

This article also mentions the resistance of the people of the region and their anti-colonial efforts. Although the conditions at that time were very difficult, signs of awakening were still visible among the Muslims. The author believes that unity among Muslims and the struggle for their rights is the only way to face this oppression and aggression of colonialism.

This historical text is a portrait of the efforts in 1920 when intellectuals of that time wanted to raise people's awareness about colonial policies and encourage them to think about their own future.

On the path to freedom

After the creation of this section for the knowledge and awakening of the people of our Pashtunkhwa, the need for a great series for its development was felt. One of its main goals was to awaken the nation and recognize their rights and the enemy's conspiracies. By starting this series, we have performed a great service to our nation; therefore, we have taken a step on the path of a great struggle for the unity of our people and the attainment of independence, so that we may free our nation from the shackles of colonialism and show them the way to lead a prosperous life. On this path, we are facing many difficult problems, but with God's help and the support of our people, we will succeed, Insha'Allah.
3271.left: On this path, we are moving towards a struggle the result of which will be the building of a new Afghanistan; in this struggle, the contribution of every Pashtun brother is essential, wherever he may be in the country; he must participate in this struggle with full courage and love so that a foundation for a bright and free future can be laid for the next generation. Although the path of this struggle is difficult, with the help of God (SWT) and the unity of the people, we will reach the destination of victory. Sacrifice for the freedom of one’s land is the duty of every Muslim and every Pashtun; this is the path of truth, and the path of truth never fails. We hope that this small step of ours will become a cause for the awakening of the entire nation and will play its role in the development of our homeland.

3287.right:
Pashtun 9 27 October 1920

Bombing on the free tribes!

A question letter to Duki Baba

Babaji! In the All India BBC Pashto news, I heard that as a result of a brief notification regarding the British bombing of the tribes, many people have been killed and injured due to the bombing in the tribal areas. This is not new; whenever the British get even a little afraid of quenching the tribes' thirst for freedom, they rain bombs on these people from their aircraft. This policy of tyranny and oppression of theirs has been ongoing for a long time. Now they are trying to find a justification for their such cruel acts under the guise of politics. They consider the tribal areas a threat to their colonialism, while the tribal people are ready for any kind of sacrifice to defend themselves, their homes, and their religious sanctities in order to get rid of British slavery. The British claim that the tribal people are a threat to security for demanding their rights is a baseless lie. The truth is that the tribes have never opened the way for the British colonialism in their areas, nor will they ever do so. These acts of the British are not only against human rights, but they also reflect such a shameless policy that is detestable to everyone at the international level. With such acts by the British, the hatred against them in the hearts of the tribal people has increased even further. This act of the British is part of a policy that wants to make the tribal people subservient to them and take away their freedom. These acts of the British will cause their downfall, because the desire for freedom of a nation can never be defeated. These acts of the British will give birth to new sentiments among the tribal people, the result of which will be in the form of the end of their colonialism. These sacrifices of the tribal people will pave the way for a historical revolution. This tyranny of the British will one day become the cause of their destruction, because the demand for truth can never be stopped.

3306.right:
Pashtun

First Edition

Friends, it has been known that a thief does not stop trying. So, if we do not strive in the path of truth against oppression and tyranny in the matters of life, we will have lost our honor and rights.

You will surely know what kind of theft and hardship we have faced. Some of you have thought to yourselves that, like others, those in power will not commit acts of oppression. But this thought and thinking of yours is wrong. Do not tie anyone else's hands and feet to yourselves, and do not be happy thinking you have done someone a favor. Oppression is not always the same for everyone. If someone oppresses you today, tomorrow they will be burning in the fire of oppression against someone else. So, join hands with everyone through your own hard work, because there is only one way to end oppression, and that is unity.

Today and tomorrow, the people's demand is for me to give you a lesson in independence and unity. Remember that the honor and dignity of every nation in the world have been elevated due to their independence and unity. Those who are bound in the chains of slavery live like animals. So, instead of living in slavery, it is better to sacrifice for your life and honor.

I tell you that you should also understand that a king of this country, no matter what kind he is, will demand much from you in protecting your rights and safeguarding the nation. Therefore, this means that every citizen of the country has a right upon them, but there are also people among them who are involved in these oppressions just like others. They look at their own interests instead of the honor and dignity of their nation. So, for the sake of protecting the independence and honor of the nation's citizens, you must join hands in unity and fight against every kind of tyrant to obtain your rights. In order for there to be peace and prosperity in the country in the future, you must take steps in unity for the honor of yourselves and your homeland, and raise your voice for your rights against the oppression of the tyrant.

3309.right:
Acknowledgment

In the name of Mahatma Gandhi, the honorary president of the Indian National Congress and leader of the national movement

Mr. Gandhi! Ever since our freedom movement has taken steps toward unity and coordination with the Indian freedom movement, we have been supporters of every step on this great path of independence. In the mutual solidarity of the Muslims of India and the freedom fighters, we see signs of the defeat of colonialism. In the light of your leadership, India has emerged as a force capable of shaking the foundations of the world's colonial powers. This acknowledgment from the leaders of our nation is intended to express our complete sympathy with the Indian independence movement. We consider the freedom of India an essential step for the stability of our region and the restoration of the rights of the people. May God lead the Indian nation to its goals under your leadership.
3309.left: In this section, we commend the efforts that have been put into place for unity between the Muslims and the Hindu nation of India. The anti-colonial struggle is the common goal of all, and in this path, we value your sincerity and sacrifice. We believe that the sun of India's freedom will shine very soon and will be a message of awakening for all Asian nations. With respect, from the supporters of your struggle, on behalf of the center of the movement for India's freedom seekers.

3329.right: The first point of enmity between India and England is that the British hold the empire of India in their hands, but due to their atrocities and the existence of their rule, the hearts of the people in India are filled with resentment against them. They are striving to gain their freedom and save themselves from the clutches of British colonialism. Furthermore, the hatred of the people regarding England's actions in India and the initiation of national movements to end their rule indicate that England's dominion in this region is heading toward decline. These movements are not only for political changes but also for the preservation of religious and cultural identity. The unity between India's Muslims and Hindus is a major threat to the British, because by dividing them, the British had maintained their power, but now the people have realized who their true enemy is and how they can fight for their rights.
3329.left: The uprising of the people of India is a reaction against the colonial policies of the British. Wherever there are signs of British rule, voices of public dissatisfaction are heard. Alongside this, the reaction of Afghans regarding British interference and their colonial policies in Afghanistan is also an important part of history. The British have always tried to interfere in the affairs of the region and increase their influence, but the sacrifices of the Afghans and their spirit of desiring freedom have remained a major obstacle to these sinister goals of the British. This article reveals the truths that have been written in the pages of history regarding British colonialism and shows how the people of India and Afghanistan have struggled for a common goal to end British rule.

An important and necessary address!

O, brothers and sisters of my homeland! Listen to these few lines of mine for your life with the ears of your heart and reflect upon them.

Today, we are in such dark shadows of slavery that in these dark shadows, we have no path to walk on our own feet. The sword of British oppression hangs over our heads, and no sign of independence is visible in our homeland. Many nations have passed on the face of the earth who were in such darkness, but they ended these shadows through their unity, their courage, and by standing firm on their religion, and once again became worthy of living in the light of independence.

Today, as I address you, it is based on the love for my homeland and the painful sentiments of my heart. This is the voice of my heart that a lamp of independence should be lit in the heart of every Pashtun that will never be extinguished again. The blood that flowed in the veins of our ancestors was the blood of freedom. They wrote the history of independence with their swords, and today it is our duty to keep their history alive.
3343.left:
There is no place for slavery in our religion. Islam teaches us the lesson of freedom and earning our own rights. Today, the demand of the time is that we must equip ourselves with the weapon of education and knowledge, because independence is not possible without knowledge. Knowledge is a light that breaks all kinds of chains of slavery.

Youth of my homeland! You must move forward in the field of knowledge for the progress of your country. End discord among yourselves and work for a single goal as one Pashtun. Read your history and value your national identity.

In the end, I say to you all: let us join hands in unity and struggle to build a Pakhtunkhwa where every Pashtun holds their head high. May God grant us all the ability to recognize our rights and put blessings in our unity.

Your brother

Abdul Hai Habibi

We hope that it will remain as a torch for the future generation so that they may preserve their language and literature.

Regarding the publication, we submit to all respected readers that we are issuing this magazine at a time when there is a surge of chaos, noise, and uproar throughout the world, for the service of the children of the homeland, and we hope that it will be a major step in increasing people's knowledge and learning. For the well-being of Pakhtunkhwa and the Pashtuns, this magazine is like a torch illuminating dark paths and means raising a voice for the unity of the Pashtuns and their rights.
In this magazine, we hope that those who can serve their people and homeland through the pen will send us their writings. We publish the writing of anyone that is for the unity of the Pashtuns, the popularization of education, and the ensuring of social justice. The magazine's management is free from any kind of prejudice and works solely with the intention of serving the homeland, and we hope for your cooperation in this path.
3361.left:
In this magazine, along with historical, literary, and social topics, a rich section of scientific and artistic content will also be included. Works and writings of past poets and writers will also be featured for the advancement of Pashto literature and language so that new generations may be informed by and benefit from the knowledge and excellence of our ancestors and elders.
We consider this a part of our national mission to work continuously for the enrichment of the Pashto language and to support everyone who contributes to the development of Pashto. We hope that this magazine will play its constructive role in the unity of Pashtuns, raising their level of knowledge, and building a bright future.
On behalf of the administration, we wish everyone a good and useful life. We thank everyone who helps us on this path and guides us with their writings, opinions, and advice. Goodbye (God be with you), hoping for your success.

Twenty-two years had passed since these words, full of pain and love from the depths of my heart, were hidden in my heart and could not be revealed to anyone. Today, that thirst for pain and love was quenched when, upon seeing his beauty, the door of my heart's chamber opened, and upon seeing his face, the words full of the pain and love of my heart came to my lips and I wrote them on the forehead of the paper. These are the words full of my heart's love, which are as follows.

Dear readers! I was trying to find such words for the expression of these words of the mouth that would not be lacking in fulfilling the love of the heart, and with great effort, by collecting a few sentences to express the love of the heart, I present this writing of mine in your presence and I hope that you will be happy from the heart upon seeing this small effort of mine.
3385.left:
I was hoping that by seeing these thoughts, you would look with respect at the words born from the blood of the heart, and by showing your encouragement in this literary work of mine, you would pray from your heart for my success.

In writing these words, I neither cared for anyone nor did I fear anyone's reproach; there was simply nothing before me but the light of His beauty. It was this love of beauty that prepared me for this writing, and by writing this, I give solace to my heart and hope that these words, filled with the love of my heart, will be a cause of joy for your mind and peace for your heart.

3390.right:
First, the editorial

We can say with certainty that this day is a day of great happiness for Pashto, because it has long been the hope of our national leaders for the development of a common language for Pashtuns and the spread of knowledge that we should have a center for this sacred purpose, and through this center, we could attend to all our national and scientific matters, and serve all our Pashtun brothers through this language, and today, by the grace of God, our long-held hopes have reached the stage of completion, and with the laying of the foundation of this center, we have taken steps toward a goal without which the progress and happiness of any nation is impossible, and by laying the foundation of this center, we have placed our steps on the path of sincerity for such unity.

Now we call upon all our Pashtun brothers, especially those who have stepped into the field of knowledge, to provide their full support in making this center a success, and for this national purpose, they should not hesitate to provide any kind of service with their pens and through their pens in awakening their Pashtun brothers, and they should devote all their efforts to this national work, because the progress and happiness of our entire nation is hidden in the success of this center, and it is the duty and obligation of every single Pashtun to participate in it according to their means for the sake of making this center successful, to provide all kinds of cooperation from their side for the development of this center, and to make their efforts for the unity of this center.

We can say with great confidence that if all our Pashtun brothers unite their steps in this national work, then in a very short time we will be able to render great services to our nation through this center, and through this center our national unity will become even stronger, and a foundation of knowledge and wisdom will be laid for our future generation from which our future generation will benefit greatly, and through this center many works will be done for the development of our language and literature, and the doors of this center will always be open for new writings and new literature in our language, and for anyone who wants to serve in this field, the opportunity to spread their knowledge and literature will be provided through this center, and in this way, the path for the development of our language will be cleared, and we will hold our heads high among other nations of the world, and after this first step, we will take even greater strides, and by the grace of God, we will be successful in the path of this national work.

In the end, we thank from the bottom of our hearts all those who have helped with their whole hearts in laying the foundation of this center, and we ask God Almighty for their reward and merit, and we hope that they will continue their support in the development of this national center in the future as well, and for this work, they will spread the message of unity and agreement among all their Pashtun brothers, and they will offer their prayers for the success of this center in the court of God Almighty, and we ask God Almighty for the exaltation of this center, and in conclusion, we pray for the success of all and ask for the strength to remain steadfast in our work.

Question: If a person intends to fast for the month of Ramadan in one month and then in the same month intends to fast for another month, are these intentions valid or not?
Answer: The intention to fast for the month of Ramadan is valid in every month, but if the intention to fast for another month is made at a time when the intention to fast for the month of Ramadan has already been made, then all these intentions are valid, because the fasting of each month is a special worship for that month and every worship requires its own specific intention.
Question: If someone makes the intention to fast during the month of Ramadan and then later changes their intention during the month of Ramadan, what will be the status of their fast?
Answer: The intention to fast in the month of Ramadan is validated by making it once, and if someone changes their intention, it does not affect their fast, because the intention to fast at the beginning of the month is sufficient.

3490.right:
Appeal

It has been the rule of all the nations of the world that whenever special circumstances have arisen in a nation, country, or homeland, everyone has sensed the delicacy of the time according to those circumstances. They have abandoned their own tasks and have prioritized collective national work. When we ponder over the situation of our country, it becomes clear that we are facing a matter of life and death in such a strange era for this country. I tell the whole nation in general and the national workers in particular to sense the delicacy of the time and gather at one center to build the future of their nation. It is a matter of great regret that our workers are still busy with disputes and divisions, and in the struggle, there is a lack of unity and foresight. Everyone should remember that nations have only progressed when a group of selfless people emerged among them who served their nation solely for the sake of God. It is my firm belief that the misery we are currently facing is due to the fact that we have cast aside all collective interests and benefits to pursue our own selfish ends. I have decided to gather all the workers at the center after Ramadan, consult with them, and then embark on collective work. Therefore, those who wish to work with me at the center should send me their names during Ramadan.

(Abdul Ghaffar)

15 August 1920
Pashtun
You have set examples. They are worthy of being written in the history of India in golden letters. The hand of time cannot destroy the path of freedom you have walked upon. No pen can erase the worthy judgment you have added to the book of eternity.
Sweet Badshah Khan! This was only the bravery and self-sacrifice of you and the Khudai Khidmatgars. This was also only the result of your patience and steadfastness, that the British laid down their arms and announced that they could no longer remain in India. Those Britishers who had defeated strong governments like Germany and Japan.
Brave man of the field! It was your trained or untrained soldiers and the mujahideen sacrificing under your leadership, who drank the cups of martyrdom for the freedom of their beloved homeland and the progress of the beautiful Islam, and until the Day of Judgment, they will remain as beacons of honor in their graves. They wrote the history of India with their blood in the Qissa Khwani Bazaar. They marched towards the front of freedom in 1932 and again in 1922. They bared their chests to the bullets of British imperialism to win their honor and dignity, sacrificing their lives and wealth for it.
Khushhal Khan of the present era! Along with the goal of freedom, the organization and progress of the Pashtun nation has also remained the beloved goal of your life. It is the result of your continuous struggle that today, the Pashtun stands shoulder to shoulder with the other nations of India in the field of constitutional and cultural progress. The Pashtuns will always be proud of you.

3497.right:
Pashtun
O caravan leader of the Pashtuns! We fully agree with the voice you have raised for the restoration of the prosperity of the Pashtuns amidst the current political changes in the country, and with your decision to boycott the referendum of the two opposing sides.
Since this is now a question of life and death for the Pashtun and the poor, and we are facing a very delicate situation, God willing, there is hope that through your guidance in these decisive moments, the Muslims of the frontier will also succeed in this final test. And the Pashtun’s own government will be established, which will be the flag-bearer of complete service to the country and the complete protection of the religion of Islam.
In the end, we express our deep gratitude for the trouble you took in the process of submitting the petition.
We are your loyal (devoted) common people.
(M. Muhammad Arif Naseem, Secretary of the Reception Committee, Ghareebabad, Rustam)

The First Message of the Islamic World

Armi year 1920, corresponding to the 1st of Shawwal al-Mukarram

Pashtoonur, through the national sentiment of Pashtunkhwa and the pens of its brave youth, has published the "First Message." This message is the voice of the hearts of all Muslims of the world, especially the Muslims of India, which they have raised against British imperialism. This message is intended to expose the atrocities of colonialism and their ruthless actions, so that the world may understand that the Muslims of India are not only fighting for their independence but are also committed to the unity and honor of the Islamic world.

In this message, light has been shed on several points: First, the sufferings of the Muslims of India and the series of atrocities against them, which have now reached their peak. Second, the declaration of support by the Muslims of India regarding the independence of Afghanistan. We believe that the independence of Afghanistan is the path to success and honor for all Muslims. Third, support for the Khilafat Movement and the readiness to make any sacrifice in this path.

We declare clearly that this message of ours is not under anyone's direction, but is our own decision for independence and national interests. We will not remain silent against these atrocities of the British government, but will continue to fight for our rights. The voice of the hearts of the Muslims of India is that they must unite to achieve independence. Our goal is not only to break the chains of colonialism, but also to fight for the unity of the Islamic world. This message is the interpreter of the aspirations of the Muslims of India, and we will fight until we have achieved our independence.

3509.right: We have no answer to the Afghans' demand for the right to vote, which they had made to the Government of India in order to obtain their rights; however, if anything is to be said about this action of the Government of India, it would be: what policy did the Government of India adopt regarding Afghans after the establishment of this new system of the Afghan government? For example: regarding the issue of the borders and what they have done concerning the rights of our nation, when we examine this, we have nothing but regret regarding the policy that the Government of India adopted on the issue of Afghanistan's borders, because for its own interests, this government was in conflict with the interests of the people of Afghanistan in this matter, and it did not refrain from any efforts for its own gain. Now, when we think about the current policy of the Government of India regarding this issue, a new path appears before us, and before thinking about this new path in any way, signs of doubt and suspicion are seen regarding the Government of India's policy towards Afghans, and if one were to ask about the current efforts of the Government of India to resolve this issue, we must say that this matter should be discussed with the officials of the Government of India, because no specific or credible step has been taken by the officials of the Government of India to resolve this issue, nor is there any sign of the Government of India's policy on this matter in the light of which it could be said that the Government of India has achieved any success in this path.
3509.left: In conclusion, regarding how the government of India has treated the interests of the Afghan nation in the issue of Afghanistan's borders, it must be said that the government of India, in accordance with its colonial policy, has always tried to sow discord among Afghans and prevent their unity. This policy led to an atmosphere of distrust between the people of both countries, and as a result of this discord, the Indian government's approach toward the people of Afghanistan turned into a situation that was unacceptable to the people. Because the Indian government was seeking its own colonial interests, it never viewed the border issue through the lens of justice and fairness, and it always attempted to interfere in Afghanistan's internal affairs under one pretext or another. This action has caused the anger of the Afghans, and the reaction of the Afghans toward this type of policy by the Indian government demonstrates that the Afghan nation will never submit to this type of colonial policy of the Indian government, and they will fight to the last limit to protect their country's territorial integrity and independence, and they will not turn away from any sacrifice in the path of this struggle. This type of unjust policy by the Indian government has caused an atmosphere of hatred and animosity to prevail instead of the establishment of friendly relations between the two neighboring countries, and to eliminate this atmosphere, the Indian government must change its policy and respect the rights of the Afghan nation.

3510.right:
Which is the way to salvation from the clutches of colonial oppression, the series of sacrifices by many patriotic Muslims in this path is still ongoing.

[Towards Freedom]
But for the sake of winning this freedom, the need for awakening and education is greater than anything else. In the light of knowledge, we can find the way to resist the oppressors. We must understand that education is not just reading books, but knowing one's country, history, and rights. If we equip our youth with the ornament of knowledge, we will stand like a strong wall against any kind of conspiracy of colonialism. It is the duty of every Muslim to work day and night to acquire knowledge and light the lamp of enlightenment in their society.

[About their bravery]
Rahmatullah Khan is the name that remains in the hearts of the people as a hero. He was prepared to endure any kind of hardship in the path of the struggle for the rights of his people. Stories of his bravery are told in every home even today, and his sacrifice serves as a torch for us. He made tireless efforts not only for his land but also for the strengthening of Islamic brotherhood.
3510.left:
We must prevent the conspiracies of those enemies who want to sow division among Muslims. We must strive to strengthen unity and understand that our strength lies in our unity. At this critical time, it is the duty of every Afghan and every Muslim to take steady steps on the path of truth.

People's reactions to this newly established system called Pakistan have emerged as a new wave in various regions. Many people believe that this system will be a new phase for the freedom and welfare of the people. However, there are many challenges along this path that must be addressed. Improving education, health, and the standard of living for the people is a fundamental condition for the survival of this system.

The unity of Muslims' hearts and the establishment of a system in which the rights of all people are protected is the only way we can lead our country towards prosperity. By spreading knowledge and wisdom, we can learn from the mistakes of the past historical era and build a new, bright future for our children.

3514.right:
Question: What is the ruling from the perspective of Islam regarding women's education? Do women have the right to education in Islam or not?
Answer: From the perspective of the blessed religion of Islam, seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim man and woman. There is no restriction of any kind in Islam regarding women's education; rather, there is an emphasis on seeking knowledge in numerous Hadiths and prophetic instructions. The great Prophet of Islam, Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH), has said that seeking knowledge is the duty of every Muslim. Therefore, the right of women to education is protected in Islam, and no one can deprive them of this right. In the early days of Islam, there were many women who accomplished great feats in the field of knowledge and contributed to the development of society.
Question: From the perspective of Islam, what is the concept of social justice?
Answer: In Islam, the concept of social justice is very broad. Justice is one of the important pillars of Islam. Allah Almighty has commanded justice in the Holy Quran. Justice is not only in the court, but the establishment of justice is mandatory in all affairs, from the framework of the family to society. Islam is opposed to class discrimination and emphasizes equality among all human beings. In Islamic law, there is no difference between the ruler and the ruled. Everyone who has a right must be given it, and no one's right should be violated.
3514.left:
Question: What is your opinion regarding civilization?
Answer: Civilization is a stage in which a nation progresses in the fields of science, art, technology, and ethics. Civilization is not only material progress, but also moral elevation. Islam also supports civilization and encourages people towards knowledge, reflection, and innovation. The civilization that is beneficial for humanity and helps in maintaining the boundaries of ethics and humanity is commendable from the Islamic perspective.
Question: What is your message regarding the world today?
Answer: My message to the people of the world is to choose peace and brotherhood. Today's world is burning in the fire of conflicts and miseries. The only way to get out of these crises is to understand each other's rights, respect others, and adopt just policies. Islam is a religion of peace and emphasizes love and cooperation among humans. It is hoped that the future of the world will be bright based on justice and ethics.

When this news was published in the newspapers, many discussions began regarding its authenticity. This matter was on everyone's lips and everyone was commenting according to their own opinion, because it was a major threat to the country's security. This was not a matter that could be easily ignored, but rather it was a cause for concern for every informed person and well-wisher of the country.
At this time, publication officials and opinion leaders presented their own views on this topic. Some said it was a conspiracy and others said it was a sign of the government's weakness. But in reality, this matter was much deeper than to be wrapped up in just a few sentences.
In the light of this matter, a kind of distrust arose among the people, because the gap between the government and the public was increasing with each passing day. This distrust caused people to become victims of disagreement among themselves as well. Many people formed their own groups in their areas to protect themselves, which led to even more chaos.
In these circumstances, in order to maintain the unity of the country, there was a need to work on a policy that all people could gather around, but unfortunately, no one was found to shoulder this heavy burden.
3518.left:
At this time, another incident occurred that stirred waves of anxiety in the hearts of the people. This incident involved a village leader who had been threatened in harsh terms by a group while expressing his opinion on the matter. This threat forced him to leave the village for some time.
The situation in the village is deteriorating day by day, and hatred among the people toward one another is increasing. Those who previously lived together in brotherhood are now caught up in enmity and malice. The cause of this situation is not just political differences; the weakening of cultural and social relations has also contributed to it.
In my opinion, if we want to change this situation, we must be tolerant of one another and resolve our problems through dialogue. A society can never be built through force and coercion alone. It is necessary for the village elders to gather and find a permanent solution to this problem; otherwise, this fire will consume the entire village in its flames, and then there will be no time left for regret.

3519.right:
In this series, a decision made by a judge of the Republic's judiciary was deemed contrary to the judge's decision by the Kabul Ministry of Justice, and they declared the judge's decision null and void. In this decision, the Kabul Ministry of Justice stated that the judge had not made the decision based on Sharia and had acted against the country's laws. By issuing this order, the Kabul Ministry of Justice ordered the formation of another court and appointed a team of new judges to re-examine the case. The new judges' decision regarding the case was much different from the previous one and was in accordance with the country's laws.

Regarding this incident, the Kabul Ministry of Justice, by issuing a statement to inform the public, stated that in all courts of the country, judges' decisions must be based on Sharia and law, and no judge has the right to make a decision according to their own preference. At the end of this order, the Kabul Ministry of Justice issued a new guideline for all judges, stating that for court decisions, they must act in accordance with the country's laws and Sharia principles.

In this guideline, it was stated that every judge must be very careful in performing their duties and use all their efforts to protect the rights of the people of the country. Also, at the end of this guideline, it was stated that if any judge makes a decision contrary to the country's laws and Sharia principles, strict legal steps will be taken against them.
3519.left:
This action by the country's Ministry of Justice became a cause for public happiness and greatly helped in increasing trust regarding justice among the people. Furthermore, through this action, the rights of the people were protected within the framework of the country's laws, and a major step was taken in the establishment of justice.

By observing the public reactions regarding the case, the Ministry of Justice was able to start a new phase in the establishment of justice and create a new trust among the people for ensuring justice. Furthermore, through this action, the Kabul Ministry of Justice created a new model for ensuring justice in other parts of the country as well, and took steps toward starting a new policy for the establishment of justice and fairness in all courts.

In conclusion, the Kabul Ministry of Justice once again stated in its announcement to remove public doubts that justice is the most essential element for the country's progress and without justice, no country can progress. At the end of this announcement, the Kabul Ministry of Justice asked the people to cooperate with the country's government for the establishment of justice and to play their part in implementing the country's laws and the principles of Sharia. As a result of this cooperation, the way was paved for strengthening the country's justice system, and a new phase began for the protection of people's rights.

3520.right: I consider it a social obligation. In the tribal areas, due to a lack of awareness regarding the benefits and losses of their fellow countrymen—similar to people in other cities of the country—the sellers of goods become victims of public misconceptions. And when the news spread in other parts of the country that the government had made preparations to build and open schools for the education of the people, the people of the tribal areas welcomed this news with great enthusiasm and expressed their happiness at this government initiative, because they had been deprived of the blessing of education and were looking for such an opportunity to provide their children with the environment for education and upbringing. However, it is a place of regret that due to the propaganda of the country's enemies and because of ignorance, this hope of theirs has not been fulfilled yet, and the children of these people remain deprived of the light of knowledge and education, while it is the duty of the state to provide the environment for education and training for all citizens of the country and lead them toward progress. For this reason, a special program must be implemented by the government to spread education in the tribal areas, and education experts and teachers should be sent to these areas to enlighten and train these people so that they can be prepared to serve their country and nation. Alongside this, it is necessary to take into account the problems and needs of the people of these areas and take practical steps for their social and economic development.
3520.left: If the walls of ignorance and unawareness are removed from before the people of one part of the country, they too will contribute to the progress of the country and will stand as a strong force in the defense of their country. In this regard, the role of media and education dissemination institutions is very important. They must accelerate efforts for public awareness and inform them about the value of education in simple language. Similarly, religious scholars and influential figures should also be utilized in awakening the people, because they have great influence among the people and people accept their words easily. It is worth noting that just building schools is not enough, but attention should also be paid to the quality of education so that students can become useful citizens for the development of the country in the future. It is the government's duty to allocate sufficient budget for education and provide necessary facilities for teachers' salaries and the construction of school buildings. Besides this, programs should also be considered for training teachers and increasing their capabilities. Finally, it must be said that despite the difficulties and obstacles in the way of spreading education, it should be the sense of responsibility of every individual in the country to play their part in spreading education and work for the enlightenment of the future generation.

3521.right: In this publication, all these hardships and sufferings, which are a burden on the shoulders of this poor and powerless nation, and in reality, are all due to ignorance, hunger, and illness, have been presented in a language that reflects the causes of the nation's misfortunes, commensurate with the educational level and life needs of the society's members; likewise, an effort has been made to describe all the factors that have become obstacles in the path of the society's progress and prosperity, and in this sequence, it is intended to pave the way for raising the level of awareness among the people and to open a path for the scholars and opinion-makers of this society to seek solutions to the society's problems; in this regard, this publication can be used as an important tool for the progress and well-being of the society, and by publishing it, the goal of its operators is to work towards creating coordination among the intellectuals and opinion-makers within the nation, and through this publication, create a suitable space for the exchange of knowledge and ideas necessary for the progress and prosperity of the society; furthermore, to achieve the goals of this publication, it is essential for every member of the society to recognize their responsibility and strive together to achieve these goals; ultimately, this publication can be used as a means for the unity and progress of the society, instilling in the heart of every citizen a spirit of love and sacrifice for their country and their people, and by publishing it, the operators hope to light the candles of knowledge and enlightenment in the life of every member of the society, thereby creating a strong bridge between the past and future of this society, inspiring hope for a bright future for every individual, and, through this publication, reviving the glorious history of the Afghans once again.

This struggle was not only for the people of India but was a great victory for all those people who are fighting against colonialism.

In the economic dealings of the Ghilzai people, it was in this manner:

At this stage, the goods of all traders that entered Afghanistan via the trade routes passing through the Ghilzai region—and the routes coming to Afghanistan from India—were in the hands of the British government due to the Afghan government's control over these same routes. According to the laws of that government, a tax proportionate to the value of the goods was collected from every trader. This tax was collected through agents appointed by the British government, who would deposit all these funds into the Indian government treasury for the benefit of the British. In return, they had not taken any steps or made any arrangements for the security of the tribes in that region. Meanwhile, these tribes had been deprived of any kind of assistance from the British government for their livelihood in this region since ancient times. For the sake of their own survival and the security of their region, they had made their own arrangements, which the British government did not interfere with in this regard. However, these acts of oppression and injustice by the British regarding the lives of these tribes became the cause of their awakening. The leaders of these tribes decided to put an end to this British influence and contacted the Afghan government regarding this issue. The Afghan government supported their decision and authorized them to stop all these illegal activities that the British were carrying out in their region and collecting money for their own government. All these unjust efforts by the British government were brought to a complete halt. With the departure of those British, a new phase began for the influence of the Afghan government in the affairs of these tribes and for their independence, and these tribes were saved from the colonial clutches of the British.

At the same time, there are also narrations about the life of Sheikh Abdur Rahman that he was a great mystic and saint of his time. Regarding Rahman Baba, it appears that there are many such narrations about his life that say a lot about the circumstances of his life in this regard.

There is no doubt that Rahman Baba was a very great scholar and learned man of his time. In his poems, there is much about mysticism, Sufism, and love on the path of God. His poetry holds a very high position in the history of Pashto literature. In his poetry, there are such concepts that find their way into the hearts of people at all times.

One of the important aspects of Rahman Baba's poetry is the simplicity and fluency of his speech. The strength and impact that exist in his speech are the result of his sincerity and his love for God. Rahman Baba's poems are not only a great asset for Pashto literature, but they are also very worthy of appreciation for morality and humanity.
3526.left:
It is also said about Rahman Baba that he was often in contact with people in different parts of his life. During his lifetime, incidents occurred that reveal much about his personality. The reflection of these incidents is very well seen in Rahman Baba's poetry.

In the poems of Rahman Baba, the image of a poet is presented who faced the social and moral problems of his time. It appears from his poems that he had a great interest in the reform of society. Another aspect of Rahman Baba's work is the spirit of humanism, where in every verse, he has spoken about human value and dignity.

One of the characteristics of Rahman Baba's poetry is that he has expressed deep concepts with great simplicity. In his poems, there are lessons of love, loyalty, and submission to the path of God. In the field of Pashto literature, Rahman Baba is a name that will always be remembered with respect. Further research on his life is very necessary for Pashto literature.

Editorial

Laar Magazine

After three successive political bans, the "Laar" magazine of the entire Pashtun nation has been resumed. The outline presented here, reflecting its specific vision and intentions to forge a "path" (Laar) for democracy, is something no power on earth can change. When "Laar" was previously refused printing by the public press "Khabnatun," this thought had arisen even among the party ranks: what is the reason that while our other separate magazines and newspapers were being printed in printing houses, the nation faced major obstacles in printing "Laar"? This created concerns, thoughts, and doubts in the hearts of the party and all Pashtuns. Through the efforts of Bacha Khan, we remained steadfast on the path, ensuring that in the face of the emerging situation in Pakistan, the small political, cultural, and civil rights of the Pashtun nation, along with their guaranteed rights, would be included.

From this, we, along with other Pashto scholars and well-wishers, sent thousands of messages of protest and displeasure to the government regarding the obstacles placed in the way of the only Pashto magazine, "Laar."
We circled the bungalows of all the elites in Peshawar and Lahore, and in the end, we were told that "Laar" is a dangerous magazine, and that we should withdraw our hands and association from this administration. We were bewildered and astonished that...

3539.right:
What is such a "dangerous" thing about "Lar" that has become a thorn in the side of the Pashtuns? If those in power are upset that "Lar" translates the sentiments and emotions of the Pashtuns, then this is no crime. And if the rulers object to the form in which "Lar" chooses to publish its articles and poems, then we cannot provide a remedy, because we do not circulate this magazine in any foreign country, nor does any foreigner come to us to buy "Lar." This is a common item for the public; anyone who wants it can buy it. And if someone suspects "Lar" of why it does not, like others, necessarily advocate for the agendas and policies of official regulations—which is against public and democratic sentiments—then the answer is that this is our democratic right and our own choice.

So, just as we had a few months of pressure and restrictions on the press, this is the kind of work that happens to every newspaper and magazine. Despite these few things, we are grateful that the Information Department of Tribal Pakistan approved the request for the "Lar" press, and here "Lar" has been resumed to reach the destination of the Pashtun caravan. We express our gratitude to Sardar Abdur Rashid Khan, the Federal Minister of Information, and all other individuals who helped us in opening the path for "Lar."

It is true that all those circumstances which were born in the hearts a long time ago, if the lies and evil had not been born on that first day, the readers of "Lar" would not have been deprived for three months.

In the end, we also thank all those well-wishers who sent pressure and pleas to the government for the continuation of "Lar."

Art and Purpose
Bana Ghaland Wamand

When Aristotle, the father of literary criticism, said that art is imitation, he did not mean that the status of art is merely that of a camera, which captures or imitates whatever it sees or whatever it wants to boast about. When an artist observes something from which a meaning is derived, it is less, but for the artist, this expression is much more than that, in many respects. This excess is the artist's critical sense. This critical sense finds expression through these methods, in color and rhyme, and it is precisely this that all art and literary criticism revolves around—the color and rhyme of these two methods. This color and rhyme is what Aristotle calls "form," and it is this same color and rhyme that Plato refers to as useless and baseless. In such methods of color and rhyme, there is the aforementioned excess which is called the purpose of art. Now, it must be seen whether purpose is necessary for art or not, and we will discuss it. For Aristotle, we will once again go to Aristotle's definition of art and discuss it. Aristotle says that art is imitation. Imitation of what? Of things, nature, and the power of truth, or just imagination? Before the artist's creation, in the consciousness and subconscious, these images are formed which give him the melody of creation. When he describes or shapes these images (IMAGES), that knowledge of things or images which is the artist's own is also included in his description or expression. This personal knowledge of the artist also includes his critical sense, which selects these images, or condemns them, replaces them, or shapes images different from them. Wherever these are not in these observations, they remain for him. Now when the artist expresses, he will use this knowledge and sense.

And because it will not appear as it is in the occurrence, and according to his imagination, it will be serious; the example will be that in which the fort was not seen, the color and the inner essence of the flowers, meaning the color and scent were not similar, and he was forced to express the psychological state that had overcome him, so there were two methods of expression: either it would be such that he shows it as it should be, if it had appeared to him, it would be alongside the flowers, so that everyone could find the right of the flower in it, and due to the artist's observation, distinguishing this flower would have been considered a duty, now because money is used in it, and it is obvious that what has no imagination, he will not show it as it is, the artist has imagination, therefore because of his imagination, he wants to show this creation even more than the original. And some do it in such a way that he does what Plato says about it, meaning it comes before the eyes from the treasures, removes it from that, and what he adds to it is more apparent, and this is the apparent purpose.

Here a question arises as to whether the artist brings changes to nature for creation, and this is because nature is more inclined towards destruction than change, or if I soften my words, it is more inclined towards disorder than order, the observation of this particular quality of nature can be well understood from the analysis of children's nature, and what we call mischief, playfulness, and destructiveness is the manifestation of this quality of nature, and the duty of criticism or art is to prevent this distortion of nature, and this is the purpose.

Art is the copy of life or technically, that is, the representation of life (production or representation), and if we accept this (and there is no way to deny this), then the importance of purpose in art increases, and with this relationship, proving it will also become easy, because life itself is a purpose. And when the artist represents life, then the purpose will necessarily be with it; this would be easier to understand if we look at the eternal attributes that are in life itself, so whenever life has a purpose and a purpose is necessary with it, then this art, which is a part of life, considers a purpose necessary for itself.
3550.left:
When an artist creates, at that time he cannot distinguish between imagination or being and bad, and beauty and ugliness from his mind, and when he is engaged in creation, he expresses according to the inner observation, which also includes imagination, so the purpose of art will come into it, and whenever there is a distinction between good and bad and beauty and ugliness in every rational person, then every artist will have an inner purpose at the time of creation, which he displays in his creations in accordance with it.

If it is not so and art is not under a purpose, then there can be two situations; first, that art is purposeless, and the criticism that England [or a critic] makes of the artist is absolutely correct. It is true that art wants to take us away from reality through speech, movement, and music; it is also true that the artist wants to deceive our sense of hearing, and it is a fact that he plays with his own lips, and Aristotle's statement is completely wrong that the artist is not a copy of reality but creates the original reality. For the sake of health, we need sight, hearing, and imagination, and for the purification of our emotions, we need excitement in our emotions. In such a situation, England was right that the artist is, while art itself is the purpose. If art is the purpose itself, then the second situation is that art is the purpose itself. If art is the purpose itself, then as a junior student of art, I have three objections to this view: first, after achieving the purpose, what will be the purpose of the student of art? When there are many examples in various languages, not just one, where the artist has brought his art to perfection, to the extent that we today cite them as examples after many centuries; whether some material need will be fulfilled, or some moral purpose will be fulfilled in a few words, and in reality, the greatest objection from all sides is that at this time it is possible to use art as a means of propagating a moral and social view. Is this a good thing that we stand art as a purpose in itself?

3551.right:
Because this purpose is superior to art from an ethical perspective, and the existence of a higher purpose makes the purpose of art less significant than the higher purpose, it is an immoral act.
Art, as I have stated, is that quality of human imagination and emotions, used to express a specific reality or impression and to bring the intensity of that impression to the audience. Just as my God is a means and instrument, so too is this art a means to express a purpose in a structured way. Now, since you have colored this purpose, it should be used as such; until that time, this art, in the context of objectives where we make this instrument the very purpose, we must polish and use it. Yet, the meaning is never that we keep any purpose away from our view or mind; the status of the instrument remains what it was. Of course, in the context of the purpose, we consider it necessary that this instrument and tool be such that it is used effectively in the path of the purpose.

That art is not the purpose but merely a means or instrument, and now the question is for what purpose should this instrument be used, or what is the purpose of art, or what should it be?
Aristophanes, the famous Greek and later educator, in his own way, asks this in "The Frogs" through the character of a prominent figure, Euripides.
"Correct. Explain to me on what grounds a great poet is worthy of praise." In Greek criticism, this question and its answer hold great importance, because consciously Euripides reveals the importance of the poet, Euripides says.

If his art is genuine, his advice is correct, and he can provide some help to the nation.
In such a way that the people of the time can be captivated by the poet's creations or words.
3551.left:
According to the theory of Euripides, the purpose of art is to improve the people, which helps the nation a great deal; in the light of this same theory, Plato rejected poets because he says that whenever poets cannot fulfill this purpose, they are not fit to live in his state.
After Plato, Longinus discussed the purpose of art; he says that an artist is not a preacher to sermonize the people; the purpose of art is only beauty and the joy obtained after manifesting it. Longinus turned Plato’s purpose around. Aristotle, a student of Plato, disagrees with his teacher; he added the principle of pleasure or enjoyment to these words and calls this the purpose of art. He considers the theories of Longinus and Plato to be bitter medicine, and says that to achieve Plato’s purpose, Longinus’s principles are very necessary. After them, in every era, critics have created debates among themselves due to their association with these things. John Ruskin, Oscar Wilde, and in the present era, T.S. Eliot are three great critics of these theories. The Roman period is based on the Platonic-Aristotelian school, and the later period is related to Longinus’s idea.
Marxist-Leninist criticism is an evolutionary form of Euripides’s criticism. Marx and Lenin consider art to be for the masses and count the revolution and the establishment and consolidation of a classless society as its purpose. This is also the same "improving of affairs" that Euripides considers the purpose of art.

However, Marx and Lenin have added to this that they do not accept an artist who preaches goodness in minor things and minor works, but rather consider it a necessary means for the dissemination of total goodness; and furthermore, that Euripides lacked class consciousness, or rather, it can be said that at that time there was no fierce war between classes, whereas in Marx and Lenin's view, in the capitalist and feudal society of the bourgeoisie and the proletariat, there was a war between different classes, and it still exists today. The foundation of Marxist-Leninist criticism is on class consciousness; in the light of this criticism, the purpose of art has been determined as to what means the art of the people in the class that is being suppressed...

What I said were the strokes of my pen at the time of printing this treatise, and for the confirmation of these words, the utterances of our respected friends and poetry enthusiasts are also needed so that the way can be paved for the printing and publication of this treatise. I still have new ideas in my pen for printing this book, so that this book may become an example of knowledge and wisdom for all on this occasion. For the introduction of this book, I have set aside a special writing at the beginning of the book and a special place in the opening pages for the opinions of my friends and to express their approval and kind words regarding it. At a time when there are many lovers of poetry and art, and such words of mutual praise are seen on their lips, by bringing such words through my own pen, I want to find a way to consolidate the opinions of all scholars regarding this book. In my opinion, this is a very useful and knowledge-filled task, and regarding the publication of this book, I offer such a message as an invitation to all friends, and I think this is a very necessary and useful task for the printing of this book.

As for literature

To the beautiful lovers

In the Diwan

What I have said about poetry, the poets of this time, and their poems is only as a sign of my own thought and love for poetry. I hope that our respected readers will write their opinions about the contents of this treatise on the pages of this magazine, and I will respect all those opinions at the time of printing and publishing this treatise. This magazine will become a useful source for increasing the knowledge of all, and I hope that we will be in search of a new way to present the love of all friends and their opinions regarding this treatise. I also invite all friends from the bottom of my heart regarding the publication of this magazine to help me in printing this magazine, take their share in the publication of this magazine, strive to increase the knowledge of the readers of this magazine, join hands for the progress of this work for the sake of love for poetry, announce their cooperation for the publication of this magazine, and pray for the success of this work.

In any case, the goal of this journal of mine is only to take a step in the path of serving the Pashto language and literature, and I hope from all lovers to support me in the progress of this work, and not to refrain from any kind of effort in the path of this work, and to perform their share for the elevation of the Pashto language and its development, and with the publication of this journal, this hope will be fulfilled, and in the hope of the publication of this journal, I thank all the lovers once again.

3604.right:
There is a great distance between the value of classical literature and the literature of this new era. However, reading this book makes it seem as if this example of poetry was hidden in the chest like a precious gem, and the new literature of this new era that is on its way can very easily be compared with this ancient poetry.

This is a new face of Pashto poetry, while the value of such works in the love of new Pashto literature is very high. Every sentence, every verse, and every poem collected in this book represents the deep thinking of a knowledge that we can see even with closed eyes. This book contains features that open a new page in the history of Pashto literature, and everyone who loves literature should have this source of knowledge in their library.
3604.left:
As much as it contains words of knowledge and wisdom, it is a great house of advice and lessons for every wise and intelligent person.

The manuscripts recently discovered by Pashto literature scholars show that the scope of Pashto literature is very broad. The discussions in this book regarding the conditions of its era and the thoughts and opinions of the people of that time further increase its value. There is no doubt that our past writers and poets were very familiar with the social conditions and life challenges of their time, and they left deep traces of this in their works.

This book is, in reality, a treasure that can prove very useful for Pashto literature scholars. Printing and publishing this book is a great step in the service of Pashto literature, which we should value and strive to promote.

In the end, we thank the publisher of this book for performing this great service to literature, and we hope that they will continue this series in the same way.

Despite all these difficulties, I made my full effort to use scientific, literary, and historical material in it so that it would be useful for our readers, and I know that this is a first step and it may have many shortcomings, but I hope that my respected readers will appreciate this small service of mine, and in future issues, I will be able to use the writings of other scholars and writers as well so that this pamphlet becomes even more enriched and proves to be of greater benefit to the readers.

I have started this work with the intention of serving my country and my people, and I will not hesitate to make any kind of sacrifice in this path. It is hoped that this service of mine will be accepted by the people, and with their encouragement, I will be able to do more for my country and people and make my steps even firmer in the path of spreading knowledge and light. In the end, I thank all those who have helped me in publishing this magazine, and I hope to continue to benefit from their support in the future so that we can proceed on this path correctly and become capable of serving our country.

3606.right: In the end, amidst the fervor of the rain, that young girl tied the buds of fragrant flowers into her shawl and headed toward home in two or three minutes; there were signs of such solace and satisfaction on her face that the previous traces of hopelessness and sorrow were no longer visible, and with her shawl, she looked as if she were full of the same joy and radiant happiness as the other village girls; the flower buds on her head appeared like symbols of the scent of spring and the hopes and desires of her heart, shining in her hair like sunlight in raindrops; this girl, who had been facing the problems of her family and the harsh circumstances of life, had forgotten her sorrows in this pleasant atmosphere of rain today, and a calm had descended upon her mind that was a sign of the fading of every grief and pain in her life; when she reached home, her mother was very happy to see her, and a shower of prayers began to fall from her lips—this was the sweetest moment of her life, marking the end of all her troubles.
3606.left: Yet, in this phase of her youth, there were also signs that she felt the difficulties and sorrows on life's path were simply a part of life's experiences, which were necessary for the growth and strengthening of her character. When she was watering her flowers in her courtyard with love and pleasure, the feeling of happiness and satisfaction in her heart was reflected in the color of each flower. In her mind, there was a vision of the future that held the light of hope and joy, and signs of progress and success could be seen in every step of her life. In this journey of life, she was not alone; rather, she lived under the shade of her family's love and support, which proved to be a remedy for every sorrow and pain, and at every step of her life, the grace and blessings of Allah Almighty accompanied her, making her life like a beautiful and colorful story.

It is essential that every citizen of the country fulfills their responsibility with full honesty in the implementation and success of these reforms.
