3609.right:
In the beginning, we mention the new movement for the freedom of Pakhtunkhwa, which in reality originates from the great national and freedom-seeking achievements of the late Aman Khan, who at that time strengthened the anti-colonial and freedom-loving spirit in the hearts of Afghans. This movement was not for one region only, but was a new glad tiding for all of Pakhtunkhwa, which removed obstacles on the path to freedom. At that time, the unity of the people against the colonizers and their sacrifices are a golden chapter of history that will never be forgotten. In the light of the politics and thoughts of the late Aman Khan, a great caravan of our nation was moving towards freedom, and this caravan is still in search of its destination.

Furthermore, in this regard, it is necessary to mention those heroes who paid the price for this nation's freedom with their lives. Their sacrifices were not for themselves alone, but they lit a torch for future generations. Their struggle against colonialism was a clear distinction between truth and falsehood, which our history has recorded with pride. We must understand that the path to freedom is not easy, and for this, there is always a need to make sacrifices, just as our ancestors traveled this path with great bravery.
3609.left:
First (1): Regarding the printing of this publication, it must be said that it is a sign of the beginning of another important era for Pakhtunkhwa. The aim of this publication is to raise awareness among the people and protect their national rights, so that people become informed about their rights and raise their voices against the atrocities of colonialism.

Second (2): In the course of publishing this, we have tried to highlight the problems and challenges that exist in society. Along with this, efforts are also underway in the field of literature and culture to work for the development of the Pashto language.

Third (3): The cooperation of every patriotic Afghan is necessary for the progress of this publication. We hope that everyone will help to move this national caravan forward to the best of their ability.

Fourth (4): In this issue, we have mentioned those who have played an important role in the history of Pakhtunkhwa. Their lives and paths are an excellent guide for today's youth.

Fifth (5): In conclusion, we must say that this publication has been printed in response to a national demand. We hope that the support of the people will lead to the further strengthening of this caravan. With God's help, we will defend the rights of our nation until the end of the path of freedom.

Question: What is it that this man has come from somewhere, and what work does he do there?
Answer: This man is a servant for Afghanistan who has come from India and is an employee in an office there.
Question: What does this man do for his own people?
Answer: This man strives a lot for his people to provide them with education and brings books and educational materials for them from India.
Question: Why does this man bring books from India for Afghanistan?
Answer: Because, in this man's opinion, there is a need for knowledge in Afghanistan, and people must understand knowledge and serve their country.
Question: Is this man happy with his work?
Answer: Yes, this man is very happy with his work and feels no fatigue in the path of serving his homeland.
Question: What does this man encourage other people to do?
Answer: This man encourages other people to also strive for knowledge and take steps for the progress of their country.
Question: What kind of life does this man lead in Afghanistan?
Answer: This man is content with a simple life in Afghanistan and tries to dedicate his entire life to the service of his nation.
Question: How does this man treat the people of his country?
Answer: This man treats the people of his country with great gentleness and kindness and views them with respect.
3612.left:
The right to one's own rights; in obtaining these rights, this man is a great sacrifice in the path of service for a long time. Despite all these difficulties, this man is still steadfast in this path. There is no doubt that the deeds of this man will be a great benefit for the future generation and they will be proud of this man's deeds.

In the end, we pray to God (SWT) for the reward of this man and we pray for more success for this man's work. May God (SWT) accept this service of his and may it become a cause for reward for this man on the Day of Judgment.

3640.right: It is a matter of joy for the people of Peshawar city that these days our provincial government is taking an interest in our concerns, so that the foundation of an association can be laid in Peshawar, which would promote the literature, art, and history of the Pashtuns. In this regard, the first and foremost necessity is to open a scientific center for the development and growth of the Pashto language. Pashto language is currently passing through a stage where there is a need to explore its hidden treasures and literature in the field of art and literature, as is the case with many world languages. I have discussed this matter very carefully with the people of this place and some Pashto writers, and they are also of the opinion that establishing a Pashto academy in Peshawar is very essential. With this, not only will Pashto literature flourish, but a strong foundation will also be laid for the preservation of Pashtun history and culture. In my view, this is a very important and virtuous step by the government, which should be carried forward with full sincerity. I am ready for any kind of cooperation in this regard.
3640.left: Regarding this, I must clarify that a specific strategy should be employed for the development of the Pashto language so that Pashto literature can be recognized at an international level. Pashto is a rich and ancient language in whose fold all the cultural and historical values of the Pashtuns are embedded. I am confident that if coordination is established between the government and Pashto scholars, we will very soon see a major transformation in Pashto literature. Likewise, encouraging new Pashto writers is also very necessary so that they can work to enrich the Pashto language through their creative works. Peshawar is a major center of Pashtun knowledge and literature, and it is the right of this city that a center be established here for the Pashto language that becomes a source of pride for the Pashtuns.

The truth is that the cause of the emergence of war and conflict among the followers of Islam is not disagreement within the sacred religion of Islam, but rather the ignorance of Muslims regarding the true realities of the Islamic faith. If Muslims were aware of the truths of their religion, they would always live in an atmosphere of brotherhood and love instead of shedding each other's blood. Because the blessed religion of Islam has brought a message of peace and tranquility for all people and has forbidden all kinds of baseless wars and discord; however, the current situation indicates that people have moved away from the original teachings of their religion. Due to a lack of knowledge, people have been divided into different groups, and each group is under the impression that they are in the right and others are in the wrong, while Islam is a religion of unity. If we want to solve this problem, we must take steps toward knowledge and understanding and, with the help of religious scholars, familiarize ourselves with the true spirit of Islam so that an atmosphere of peace and brotherhood can once again prevail in the Islamic world. Anyone who wants to bring about change in Islam must first focus on reforming themselves and their own society, because reform starts from the individual and then reaches the society. We must align our lives in the light of the Holy Quran and the Seerah of the Prophet (PBUH) and stand firmly against those who choose the path of violence in the name of religion. It is the duty of every Muslim to take a step on the path of truth and reality and not remain silent in the face of falsehood. In conclusion, we must say that the only way for the progress of Islam and the unity of Muslims is the acquisition of knowledge and the acceptance of one another, so that, as in the past, the flag of Islam may be raised all over the world as a symbol of unity and honor, and the love of Islam in people's hearts may once again become alive and strong like its roots. This is a great responsibility placed on the shoulders of every Muslim, and by fulfilling it, we will attain success in this world and the hereafter. Question: When some people say: "The purpose of human creation is the worship of God", what does this mean?
Answer: The purpose of human creation is the worship of God; this statement means that man has been created in this world for the recognition of God and for His servitude. If one reflects on this, the sacred religion of Islam also emphasizes that human life should be spent in pursuit of God's pleasure. Thus, it is necessary for man to observe the commands of Allah Almighty in all his deeds and to walk in His path. In the light of Islam, human life is a great trust, which must be kept with complete honesty. The worship of God is not only in performing prayer and fasting, but all those matters that contain the pleasure of Allah Almighty are considered worship. For example, acquiring knowledge, helping others, speaking the truth, and striving for the progress of society, all of these are a part of the worship of God.
The concept of worship in the religion of Islam is very broad. It is not limited only to places of worship, but establishing justice and fairness in social life also falls under the category of worship. When a person keeps the fear of God in mind while performing his duties, then his every action takes the form of worship. In this way, all aspects of human life are connected with worship.
3651.left:
The concept of worship is very essential in human life, because it helps in shaping human morals and character. When a person realizes that every action of theirs is under God's supervision, they refrain from bad deeds. This is the reason why Islam has assigned a high status to worship in human life. This is not just for an individual, but a fundamental principle for the reform of the entire society. If all humans in the world understand that the purpose of their life is not just materialism, but the pleasure of God, then peace and tranquility will come to the world. From the perspective of Islam, worship is like a light for man that illuminates the path of his life. In this way, a person gets closer to his Creator and succeeds in both worlds.
In short, we can say that the purpose of human creation is hidden in the worship of God, and this worship, in a broad sense, is manifested in implementing the commands of Allah Almighty and in good treatment towards His creation. Whenever a person aligns their life with these principles, they achieve the main goal of their existence. This is the only way for human success.

Just as we mentioned the signs of God's power and the truth of the universe in the previous chapters, now in this chapter we will understand how this entire cosmic system is running in an organized manner and what is the wisdom of its Creator in it? Firstly, nothing has happened on its own, but rather has been created by the hand of a great Creator. Every star, every planet, and every particle moves by His command.

In the existence of man, signs of this power are also clearly visible. He has organized the structure of the human body, the blood circulation, the heartbeat, and the functioning of the brain in such a way that it is astonishing. If we contemplate each of these, we will understand the greatness and wisdom of that great Creator. He has not only created this universe but has also provided everything necessary for its survival. The facilities of food and drink for living beings on the earth are signs of His mercy.
3654.left:
Likewise, in this universe, every existing entity is obligated to work by the special command of God Almighty in search of its place and for the continuation of its life. The growth of trees on earth, the flow of rivers, and the falling of rain are all parts of His great system. If we want to change something in this whole system, it is not possible, because everything here is under a specific law.

The conclusion is that by observing this universe and the creatures within it, a human being must realize that there is one Creator and Owner of all this. He is the one who maintains the order and discipline of this universe. We should follow His commandments in gratitude to Him and reflect on the signs of His power. This is the path of knowledge and wisdom for humans to attain worldly and afterlife happiness by spending their lives in accordance with God's will.

Last night, I saw in my dream that it was the Day of Judgment. All people had gathered in a field for their accounting. A throne of great majesty and splendor was set, and upon it, God Almighty sat to question His servants about their deeds. All the people, with great humility and submission, kept their heads bowed for the questioning of their actions. In that state, I saw a man with a very beautiful and radiant appearance come and sit beside God Almighty on that throne. With a tone so soft and sweet that upon hearing it, every person's heart would find a sense of peace and tranquility, he would plead in the court of God Almighty for the forgiveness of everyone's sins. With his every plea, signs of joy would appear on the face of every sinner, and in that field, waves of divine forgiveness spread like rain of mercy. This vision was so impactful for me that I began to cry in my sleep and woke up with my heart pounding intensely. This dream presented to me such a clear picture of the reality of life that it remained in my mind for a long time, and with the realization of my own sins, I adopted the path of repentance and seeking forgiveness.

Upbringing Lesson:

The most important necessity of upbringing for a human's life is the control of one's own base desires. If a person does not restrain their self, they head toward destruction. For upbringing, it is necessary to distinguish between good and evil in doing every deed. In Islamic teachings, great emphasis has been placed on upbringing. It is the primary duty of parents to teach their children the difference between truth and falsehood. Patience and perseverance are very necessary for the improvement of character. Whoever adopts the path of patience in life reaches the station of success. The role of the environment is also very important in building a person's personality, which is why it is said that companionship with righteous people helps in improving a person's character.
3655.left: The question of human existence in relation to the creation of the universe is a reality that cannot be weighed by the intellect of scholars. When a human sees so many wonders and marvels of power before their own eyes, their heart is involuntarily drawn toward the recognition of the Creator. The fact that everything in the universe is moving in an orderly fashion is in itself proof of the existence of a great Creator. If we contemplate the structure of our own existence, there is such order in the movement of every vein, every bone, and every organ that it leaves a person immersed in wonder. In reality, this entire system of human existence bears witness to the power of a Being that no one can reach. Human life in this world is like a traveler who has come here for a short time and must return to their true place to account for their deeds. Therefore, it is necessary for every human to live in this world in a way that causes the pleasure of the Creator and prepares provisions for the eternal life of the Hereafter. It is the duty of every wise person to choose the path of truth and justice in their actions and to protect themselves from all forms of oppression and sin so that they may be spared shame on the Day of Judgment. This short period of life is like an opportunity that should be utilized by doing good deeds.

Question: What is the ruling on mentioning the name of the Prophet (peace be upon him) in the grave during the burial process, including the funeral?
Answer: Mentioning the Prophet (peace be upon him) by name in the grave during the funeral is an innovation and impermissible. This is because there is no evidence for this in Sharia.
Question: What is the ruling on placing flowers on top of a deceased person's grave?
Answer: Placing flowers or other items on a grave has no basis in the blessed religion of Islam; therefore, this action is also unacceptable.
Question: What is the ruling on building high frames or domes over graves?
Answer: Building domes or any such structures over graves, for which there is no necessity from a Sharia perspective, is an act against Islamic Sharia and is prohibited.
Question: What is the ruling for those who go to visit graves and light candles on them, or offer vows (nazrana) around the graves?
Answer: Lighting candles on graves and offering vows there is, from a Sharia perspective, a path to shirk (polytheism) and misguiding people, and one must strictly refrain from this action.
3658.left:
Question: What is the ruling on reciting the Holy Quran during the burial of a deceased person?
Answer: Reciting the Holy Quran at the time of burying the deceased, such as standing at the graveside, has no Sharia basis and this act is not supported in Islamic Sharia.
Question: What is the ruling on providing food as charity for the deceased or organizing large gatherings in memory of the dead?
Answer: Doing things in the name of charity for the deceased that have not been recommended in Islamic Sharia is an innovation (Bid'ah) and an act that is not approved from a Sharia perspective.
Question: What is the ruling on writing on graves or placing stones to mark a grave?
Answer: Sharia rulings regarding placing stones to mark graves or writing the name of the deceased are very strict; it appears from the Hadiths of the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) that fully marking graves is not in accordance with Islamic principles.
Question: What is the ruling on writing verses of the Holy Quran on the tops of the graves of the deceased?
Answer: Writing verses of the Holy Quran on graves in a place where they may be disrespected or trampled under people's feet is in no way permissible in the blessed religion of Islam.

These issues were compiled according to the fatwa of the scholars of the Darul Uloom of Kabul.

According to the author of this page, there are always obstacles on the path of life, but we should not stop in the face of these obstacles. This page is, in reality, a collection of life experiences that every reader can benefit from. 3663.right:
Ramadan and Shakro

Nawroz Khan called out to Ramadan, saying: "Brother! This is the month of Ramadan, may God accept it from all of us." Ramadan said: "Yes, may God grant us the ability to perform the acts of worship of this month." Nawroz Khan said: "Ramadan Khan! I have a request; in this month, let us do something that is useful both for the people and for the religion." Ramadan said: "That is a very good initiative, I want the same." Nawroz Khan said: "Then let us make some arrangements for the poor. Let us do something so that people become aware of each other's condition in this month and help according to their means in this way." Ramadan agreed happily and said: "This is a very good idea, let's talk to the people and invite them to do good deeds." They started this work and encouraged many people to help others during this month. Many people participated in this path, and works were done that increased love and brotherhood among the people. It seemed that this Ramadan was very different compared to others, and people were truly doing things for the sake of God's pleasure.
3663.left:
That in this path is God's pleasure, this matter spread among the people and it seemed that this month of Ramadan became a month of blessings for the people. People shared in each other's sorrows and things were done that no one had seen before. Nawroz Khan was very happy with this action of Ramadan and said: Look, Ramadan Khan! These are the hearts of the people that gather in good deeds. Ramadan said with a smile: Yes, this is a sign of faith and people understand how much reward there is in spending in the way of God.

Nawroz Khan and Ramadan were both happy that they were able to accomplish some good deeds. They thanked the people and prayed for them that God may accept their intention. With the end of this month, people congratulated each other and felt that they had been blessed with the great grace of God.

This story has remained as a lesson to people for centuries, and it has shown them that in this holy month, the greatest worship is love for servants and helping them.

3668.right:
Book

Realm of study!
O heart, you who sit in seclusion and are immersed in your books, do you know what these are? These are signs of the knowledge and wisdom of people of past eras. In these pages are contained the words of those who lived long before us. This is the voice of their hearts and a reflection of the flights of their thoughts. These books are not just papers, but signs of the evolution of the human soul.

A book is the gateway to knowledge. In it, there is knowledge of everything, whether it be of religion or the world, of the past or the future. In our civilization, the book was viewed with great respect. Our scholars and writers would spend nights busy with the movement of the pen, so that they could leave their knowledge for future generations.

Today as we look, everything in this world is in a state of change, yet the book remains the most reliable source for acquiring knowledge. If we want to take steps on the path of our nation's elevation, then we must strengthen the habit of reading.
3668.left:
The new generation must understand that a book is a torch for the path of life. A book gives man the ability to think, shows the difference between truth and falsehood, and points out the ways for the progress of society.

But it is a pity that these days some people have moved away from books. Instead of reading books, they spend their time on useless activities. This is a great loss. If we want to regain our position in the field of knowledge once again, we must look at books with great respect and make them our friends.

If we talk about the pleasure of reading, then by reading a book, a person is freed from the constraints of time and travels towards another world. This is a journey that has no end, because the world of knowledge is vast and infinite.

In conclusion, I recommend to our youth that you make books your guide. Read books, think about them, and build your life in their light. A book gives you what nothing else can give, and that is the peace of the heart and mind.

When the light of "Asia's" life spread to the east, the other people of the world, upon seeing this light, were asleep in such a slumber that they did not know at all what was happening around them. At the time of the spread of this light, a new spirit was born in the world that invited all humans to new ways of life and brought those lying in the darkness of ignorance to such a place in the field of knowledge and wisdom that they were written in golden letters in the pages of history forever.

The history of the origin of writing:

When humans learned to use language to express their feelings and thoughts, they very soon found a way to write these thoughts on paper. There are various theories regarding the origin of writing, but the most credible is that writing first began in the form of pictures, and later, with the passage of time, it turned into symbols and letters.

Are these letters that we use now the invention of any specific person? No, this is the result of the continuous efforts of humanity. By looking at the writings of ancient people, we understand that every nation created special symbols for writing according to its needs. Especially in the development of civilizations, the art of writing played a very important role.
3669.left:
Ultimately, printing books paved a new way for their distribution, which resulted in a great revolution in the field of spreading science and knowledge. The knowledge that had hitherto been hidden in manuscripts now became accessible to the common people.

In the present time, the value of books is greater than ever before. For the progress of our society, it is necessary that we promote a culture of reading, because reading is the only way to expand human thought and increase knowledge.

3671.right: For this reason, I also remained in conversation with him, and with great humility, I said to him, "Brother! Seeing my condition as you do, for God's sake, have mercy on me, and do not speak of these hardships and distresses, for they make the dark night of my life even darker." When I said this, he also began to weep, and in his own words, he said: "Brother! In this desert of life, I too am weary under the burden of sorrows and difficulties, and this dark night that you see, I too am searching within it." This was another painful story of two hearts coming together, meeting each other in this arena of life. He too was immersed in the stories of his life, and I was immersed in the sorrows of mine. This was not the time or place for such talk, nor was there a way to solve such problems. Like me, he was held captive by his fate, and the more he tried to escape, the more he became trapped in this dark snare. Like me, he was a traveler searching for his destination, but he had lost the signs of the path. In this long journey of life, he too was searching for his hopes and dreams, but all those hopes had been lost in the shadow of time. In the dark nights of this desert, he too was like a star scattered across the lap of the sky, searching for light. He began his life story by saying: "I was once in a garden of happiness and laughter, but in these harsh winds of life, all the flowers of my life withered, and now I am wandering in this desert of sorrows. This era is so merciless that it values no one's tears, nor does it care about the pains of the heart. Everyone is weighed on the scale of their own sorrow, and no one sees the pain of another." At this point, he became somewhat silent, and it seemed as if there was a great storm in his heart, but he lacked the strength to express it. I also looked at him and said in my heart: "God! What a dark stage of life this is, where everyone is searching in their own pain and finds no path to salvation."
3671.left: In this dark night, by the light of the stars, I saw myself, weighed down even more by a burden of sorrows. I placed the story of this weary traveler on the scale of my heart, and shared the companionship of his pain with my own grief. We were both searching for light in the boundless desert of this life, but the hand of fate acted in such a way that neither of us reached our destination. He was in search of life's happiness, and I was in search of my own peace. This dark night continued for a long time, and we sat in silence beside one another, like two ships lost in the middle of a storm. Every time a gust of wind came, the pains in our hearts were renewed. He said again: "Brother! In this journey of life, we have found nothing but these sorrows and weariness." I also admitted in my heart that he spoke the truth, because our whole life story is like these dark nights. At that moment, the signs of dawn appeared on the horizon, and the first rays of light spread over the body of the dark nights. These rays of light were a sign of new hope, but our hearts were still submerged in the shadows of past sorrows. We both stood up and continued on our journey, but with every step, memories of the sorrows of that night remained in our hearts. This was an example of life, how one human being shares in the pain of another, and how they offer a hand of consolation to each other on this path of life. We parted ways in a state of farewell, with the burden on our hearts even heavier, yet bound by the ties of humanity, we prayed for each other's patience and courage before going our separate ways. The story of that night became a part of our lives that will never be forgotten, for that night was a clear testament to the pains, hopes, and endless truths of life.
